overview: On New Year’s Eve, in the streets of Berlin, Alex delivers coke driving her taxi. Three other car journeys capture three earlier moments in a life marked by personal tragedy. From season to season, an interior journey into states of being.

title: Naum. Premonitions
overview: The film is about Naum Kleiman, an internationally acclaimed Eisenstein specialist and former director of the Moscow Museum of Cinema.

title: The Noise of Time
overview: In the town of Xoco, the spirit of an old villager awakens in search of its lost home. Along its journey, the ghost discovers that the town still celebrates its most important festivities, but also learns that the construction of a new commercial complex called Mítikah will threaten the existence of both the traditions and the town itself.

title: Vislumbre de Uma Noite
overview: Sofia and Aurora are two women who used to date, and on a random day, they end up running into each other and having one "last night together." The only thing is—Sofia and Aurora don't know that yet.

title: Interview
overview: An anxious woman desperately looking for work tries to survive a job interview.

title: In the Wake of Remembering
overview: Three women reflect on their memories of witnessing and supporting the Burnsall Strike, a 1992 workers' resistance movement led by Punjabi women in Smethwick. From within their memories, another voice emerges, one that engages with the domestic and personal. Together, these voices attempt to reconstruct the forgotten wholeness of the lives of South Asian women, against the political and social backdrop of life in the UK.

title: Nykil
overview: Struggling with trauma from a tragic event, Kathryn turns to a shady pharmaceutical trial. She takes the psychoactive drug "Nykil" which gives a vicious monster domain over her mind as he takes her on a bad trip into her worst nightmares..

title: When He Comes Back
overview: In Seattle, a young immigrant faces love, loyalty, and identity dilemmas. A weekend retreat meant for introspection turns eerie, forcing her to address her future against a backdrop of trauma and cultural dislocation.

title: The Book of Paradise Has No Author
original_title: The Book of Paradise Has No Author
overview: In this eclectic spin on the concert film, Ross Lipman transforms footage of one of his celebrated live documentary performances into a new video essay that's at once an archaeological dig and a riveting history. Its underlying subject is the origin of civilization - as comprised entirely of media clips. In the summer of 1971 Philippine dictator Ferdinand Marcos announced the discovery of a tribe of primitive cave dwellers who had lived in complete isolation for thousands of years in the rain forest of Mindanao. The Tasaday indigenous group represented a chance to witness firsthand the roots of our culture, and to explore the very essence of humanity. They also-as we learn-offered Marcos and his cronies a unique political opportunity.

title: The Last Dinner Party - Les Eurockéennes de Belfort 2025
original_title: The Last Dinner Party - Les Eurockéennes de Belfort 2025

title: Confessions of a Menopausal Femme Fatale
original_title: Confessions of a Menopausal Femme Fatale
overview: CONFESSIONS OF A MENOPAUSAL FEMME FATALE is a fearless stand-up storytelling concert film in which Shakoor uses raw honesty, wit, music, and personal narrative to share her 12-year journey through menopause—a transformative experience that reshaped her identity as a woman, mother, artist, and human being. Framed around a return trip to Hawaii nearly 40 years after she once called it home, the story unfolds when a panic attack triggers deep introspection, forcing Shakoor to confront unresolved struggles, including addiction, postpartum depression, loss, and self-reinvention. Through wit, song, and unflinching truth, Shakoor breaks the silence surrounding menopause in a powerful performance that challenges stigma, invites laughter, and inspires radical self-acceptance.

title: Thus Spoke the Wind
overview: Hayk, withdrawn and aloof child, lives on a farm with his aunt Narine. Local teenagers mock him, deeming him strange and weak. Narine cares for him as if he were her own son. After a lengthy stay in another country, Hayk’s mother Anahit, a beautiful woman in her late twenties, returns to the farm. The locals openly condemn her behavior because she does not follow the rules of society. Narine, unable to forgive Anahit for the shame brought upon her with her behavior, decides to take revenge.

title: There Is No Antimemetics Division
overview: Directed by Adria Lang

title: Tormento
overview: Amelie, a young woman who finds herself engulfed in unresolved grief, adds a new object to her collection that leaves her torn between nightmare and reality.

title: When Brazil Was Modern
overview: Brazilian architecture in the 20th century influenced generations of architects worldwide. But there was a time when choosing an architectural style also meant choosing a vision for the country, amidst political power struggles.

title: Sempre Avanti
overview: Two U.S. soldiers plunge into a suspected enemy combatant tunnel system during the Vietnam War only to awaken unparalleled horrors.

title: Sob Story
overview: Struggling to pay her father’s medical bills, a young woman takes a job mourning at strangers’ funerals, only to discover unexpected connections in a profession built on pretending.

title: The Deed
overview: Laki (25 years old, courageous, righteous, anxiously paranoid) is a graduate art historian, unemployed, in a perspectiveless environment, he decides to become independent at his great-grandfather's abandoned cottage.

title: Lucy
overview: Plagued by OCD and agoraphobia, Lucy hasn't left her apartment in years. But as therapy shows promise, a dark, hostile force emerges from her subconscious into reality.

title: The Rhine Gold
overview: The Reno, or Italian Rhine, may not be as renowned as its Teutonic sibling. Nevertheless, as Lorenzo Pullega’s witty and playful film informs us, the banks alongside this river, which courses through northern Italy, has its own rich and undulating history.

title: Somewhere to Belong
overview: In a stripped-down industrial building in Lisbon, two Brazilian brothers train for a jiu-jitsu championship in Rome. One shares his daily life with his girlfriend and her child. The other fights alone, while his beloved is hospitalized back in Brazil. By day, their bodies wrestle. By night, they drive taxis to send money home.

title: Kingdom
overview: Set in the near present, captures a nation on the brink of war. Due to the unstable political situation, Dawid loses his job without a warning. As his family prepares to flee the country, Dawid’s younger brother becomes involved with the only organization willing to stand against the encroaching enemy.

title: Master Scheme Singh
overview: Master Scheme follows a story of a man who schemes to be rich only to end up in trouble and comical chaos.

title: The Last Ride
overview: Desperate to secure a dowry for his sister's wedding and escape his exploitative boss, Aman – a migrant ride-share driver in Mumbai – decides to steal his boss's taxi. But his plan spirals into a nightmare when his last minute passenger turns out to be a Chudail (a demonic witch).

title: Blind Man’s Film
overview: Composed of various images from Shkodër and Ulqin in the summer of 2024, with the intent of giving the audience glimpses of beauty with an underlying sense of longing for return.

title: Li Lianmin
overview: From a personal perspective, this documentary presents the history of the local church alongside an individual’s life story.

title: Jonesing: When Love Is a Habit
original_title: Jonesing: When Love Is a Habit
overview: Simone is a young poet and college senior navigating love and self-discovery while witnessing the unraveling of her parents’ once-revered relationship. Her father, a world-renowned author whose words once defined a generation’s understanding of love, and her mother, a sought-after creative director celebrated for capturing the essence of intimacy through her lens, built a life shaped by passion, artistry, and devotion until the foundation began to crack. As their love story fades from the idealized lens of the public into the stark reality of divorce, Simone begins to question whether love is ever as real as it seems. Now in her final year of college, she stands at the crossroads between the creative world she was born into and the growing disillusionment in her heart. Just as she prepares to give up on the idea of love altogether, she meets Myles, a charismatic transfer athlete with unexpected emotional depth.

title: Made from Leakproof Plastic
overview: As Sasha prepares to leave her newly sold home after her husband's passing, his presence lingers in his paintings of her. But an unrelenting fridge leak threatens to destroy them, forcing her to confront her memories. Blending animation and live-action, the film explores loss as a quiet, persistent presence - one that seeps through the cracks, demanding to be felt.

title: Erion
overview: During an excursion in a nature reserve a few kilometers far from crowded beaches and chaos, Erion finally finds the courage to tell Christian that they will never have to see each other again.

title: Soodabeh
overview: Mehrdad marries Soodabeh, his friend's sister and colleague Siamak, and takes her to their old house to spend time with his mother, who then encounters incidents.

title: This Time Together
overview: A documentary film celebrating 25 years of a life-changing arts camp in New Hampshire called Creative Arts at Keene.

title: Will
overview: A girls’ basketball coach battles a heroin addiction while mentoring a 12-year-old street kid adopted by Will and his wife.

title: Antigona
overview: In rural North Macedonia, a determined woman begins a quiet revolution. Inheriting her father’s job as a van driver, she opens new possibilities for the women around her.

title: Reborn to Love Mr. Right
overview: Betrayed and discarded, Arianna, a wealthy heiress dies on the first day of college, only to be reborn with a chance to take revenge on the man who used her and reclaim the love she never saw coming.

title: The Rebel Phantom
overview: In the gritty underbelly of Cork City, two detectives chase the Kingpin that has made their lives hell for the last three years.

title: Gabriel
overview: Gabriel, a recent immigrant, grapples with whether to show his nationality on his resume. As he sets out to find a job the next day, he confronts the daunting task amid his language barriers. An unpleasant encounter prompts him to reflect on his family and the values they instilled in him.

title: Action Item
overview: Burn-out and depression are not individual phenomena but collective ones. The film is an invitation to rest through images and listening, so as to transform individual exhaustion into shared power to act.

title: King George
overview: After being handed an eviction notice, a wily strip club owner goes to war with a ruthless property developer.

title: Mike Vecchione: Low Income White
overview: Mike Vecchione’s “Low Income White” turns clean comedy on its head with a razor-sharp set that’s equal parts smart, self-deprecating, and relentlessly funny. With the gritty rhythm of the Northeast and the polish of a comedy veteran, Vecchione unloads a barrage of fast-paced, observational humor that hits on everything from aging and generational divides to the absurdity of modern life.  Navigating the world with sarcastic precision and deadpan charm, Vecchione doesn’t pull punches—but he doesn’t play favorites either. No one is safe, including himself. It’s clean comedy with an edge, and a masterclass in making the mundane feel hilariously high-stakes.

title: Maatonda Heluve
overview: Mayur, a Radio Jockey from Hubli-Dharwad hosts a popular show titled 'Patch Up Stories with Mayur,' where he offers heartfelt relationship advice to young couples. Despite helping couples mend their relationships, Mayur remains single, holding firmly to his belief in the 'one love for life' concept. His life takes a turn when he meets Khushi, a spirited girl from Mysore.

title: Getter Robo
overview: Live action adaptation of the Getter Robo manga.

title: Letters to My Dead Parents
overview: What do you tell your dead parents? Combining family archives and glimpses of today, the filmmaker weaves together fifty years of his life and the socio-political history of Chile. The montage wanders through the ages, between light and shadow, without ever leaving the joy.

title: Another World
overview: After death, before reincarnation, the souls of the deceased transit through a fantastical realm known as, Another World. Gudo is a spirit that helps to guide these transient souls to their reincarnation. While guiding a young girl named Yuri, he learns that humans have emotions that he does not understand. Tasked by Goddess Mira to help Yuri control her rage and prevent her transformation into a monster, Gudo embarks on a perilous mission.

title: Icarus
overview: LA-newbie Emily cannot believe her luck when Hollywood A-Lister Harris Shaw instigates a romantic entanglement, but the night takes a dark turn when his charm quickly dissolves and something darker rises to the surface.

title: Valery Meladze at the Royal Albert Hall
original_title: Валерий Меладзе в Royal Albert Hall
overview: Features live performances of Meladze’s greatest hits, as well as personal reflections on his career.

title: Outro Erro
overview: A film made twice.

title: Have a Nice Day
overview: Emmaüs’ companions repair and resell donated items. Between the warehouse and the shop, a small group takes everyday life in a different direction, presenting people and objects with humour and tenderness.

title: Childish Things
overview: A 30-year-old musician questions his resolve to marry his longtime girlfriend when he meets a free-spirited woman on his cross-country roadtrip.

title: Shayni in the Sky
overview: A BASE jumper from New Zealand returns to the Norwegian mountain where her husband, also a BASE jumper, had a fatal accident. She carries his ashes, their newborn baby, and their memories on her journey of life after death.

title: Van Pianist
overview: In 2020, Wuhan resident Haitao Peng lost his father and newborn son. He took up piano and eventually played in the city's streets, transporting it in his van. Mourning his losses, this private ritual gradually took on deeper meaning during China's nearly three-year pandemic controls, which ended abruptly in late 2022. The film reflects on the rarely discussed closing chapter of China's Zero-COVID policy and the fragile balance between public health and personal freedom.

title: Baljjeo
overview: “When Mirim turns twenty-six, she will go blind.” The prophecy of ‘Grandma Baek’ shakes Mirim’s family to its core. To escape this ominous fate, the family decides to take in a surrogate to bear the curse on their behalf. Thus, Jinkoo is brought into the household. At first, the ritual seems to succeed. Mirim’s eyesight remains intact, but Jinkoo pays a tragic price, losing his life in an accident. Years pass, and Mirim lives burdened by guilt and longing for Jinkoo. One day, a pilgrim arrives at their old family home, claiming to bridge the boundary between the living and the dead—through whom Mirim hopes to reunite with Jinkoo.

title: Érase Una Vez en el Noroeste
original_title: Érase Una Vez en el Noroeste

title: Vuela El Salvador
overview: El Salvador's most dramatic landscapes unfold all around you in this sensory-driven flight experience that captures the nation's soul from above. Soar over active volcanoes, navigate winding rivers, and witness our emerald lakes from impossible heights. Soaring exclusively at Skydeck Millennium in San Salvador.

title: Hock E Aye Vi Edgar Heap of Birds: Family - An Oral History Project
original_title: Hock E Aye Vi Edgar Heap of Birds: Family - An Oral History Project
overview: In preparation for his first major retrospective at the Oklahoma Contemporary in 2025, Hock E Aye Vi Edgar Heap of Birds reveals thoughts, formal approaches, and philosophies toward various works, including the oral history details behind his new wall installation work, Family, that continues his practice of 'primary' and 'ghost' printing.

title: Some of You Fucked Eva
overview: From a montage of visual archives gathered from YouTube emerges the social and cultural landscape of an American high school, along with a story centered on Eva, a typical cheerleader at the heart of a strange collective episode.

title: Are we all racists?
overview: In this unprecedented primetime program, 50 volunteers take part in experiments without knowing that the aim of the program is to understand the unconscious mechanisms that can lead us to discriminatory behavior. Because if they knew, it would bias the results of the experiments.

title: KHOJ
overview: A young man wanders through the ruins of his own mind, hunted by fragments of memory, trauma, and longing. As the boundaries between reality and dream dissolve, he searches for something lost.

title: LESSON
overview: Kyung-min is an English tutor who is often pressured by his lover Seon-hee about getting married. He starts giving lessons to a new student Young-won, a piano tutor, and they decide to exchange tutoring like barter. Unlike Seon-hee, she seems to be an untied person when it comes to relationships, which strongly attracts Kyung-min. But as he falls for her, he faces unexpected but familiar situations.

title: Future Future
overview: In a rainy Brazilian city, an amnesic man is taken in by a lonely clickworker at a course for people with a strange neurological syndrome. After using an addictive AI device, he embarks on a tragic and absurd journey to find where he truly belongs.

title: REMNIRA
overview: After discovering a mysterious camera that transports him into fleeting moments of the past, a grieving photography student attempts to rewrite a painful history—only to uncover the blurred line between memory, art, and reality.

title: Limbo in The Box
overview: Haunted by the weight of his failures and standing on the edge of ending it all, Sanju — a broken young man — unexpectedly crosses paths with an old college acquaintance. What follows is a heartfelt conversation that becomes the turning point in his life.

title: Le retour du Gendarme de Abobo
original_title: Le retour du Gendarme de Abobo

title: Facsimile
overview: Two investigators explore a strange cave on a Palouse farmer's property. Their discoveries quickly develop into cosmic horrors.

title: Ladies of the Lens
overview: Three women turn the camera into a tool for expression and play: from the VHS recordings of the ‘80s to the rise of TikTok, the documentary explores how their videos transcend the everyday, reinventing worlds and sharing creativity.

title: Goosebumps
overview: A horny woman finds ways to keep busy when she sends her sex robot back to the factory because he is no longer able to satisfy her.

title: White Lines
overview: When Amber discovers she is pregnant, she hides the news from her fellow drug dealing boyfriend Jacob, who spends his night snorting coke. After a chaotic night at a rave, Ambers future is left fractured and uncertain.

title: Bocadolixocinema
overview: A look into the Boca do Lixo, a square in downtown São Paulo known as a point for filmmakers, actors, and technicians who worked on low-budget films.

title: Cohousing
overview: When a headstrong teen with dreams of the big city finds out that a developer wants to buy her neighborhood, she must convince her wacky cohousing community to sell, in order to get the cash to finance her goals.

title: The Culminating Point: Unveiling The Secret
original_title: El Punto Cúlmine: Más Allá del Secreto
overview: An in-depth look at the creative process of 'The Culminating Point' with the cast, crew, and director Florencia Dufou.

title: Tin Soldiers
overview: Falling behind in class, a parent-teacher conference sends Caius down a pharmaceutical rabbit hole that impacts him for the rest of his life. As he grows, Caius must navigate the complexities of mental health treatment at a time when he's still discovering what 'normal' is.

title: O curta mais assustador que você verá hoje!
original_title: O curta mais assustador que você verá hoje!

title: Immrám
overview: Immrám is a lyrical, experimental journey through Ireland's land and language, following a family's path of cultural revival, spiritual pilgrimage, and everyday resistance guided by myth, community, and the enduring voice of philosopher John Moriarty.

title: Dog Moms
overview: Fresh off a breakup, 30-year-old and barely-holding-it-together Sasha brings her mischievous dog, Sushi, to her younger sister’s baby shower. After fielding a barrage of questions from family and friends about why she is so behind in life, Sasha notices too late that Sushi is destroying all of the baby shower gifts, and Sasha’s dad screams at her in front of everyone. Fighting back tears, Sasha grabs her dog and runs out, humiliated.

title: BAND
overview: Was it a cult? A charismatic bandleader convinces four generations of Midlands factory workers to dedicate their lives, and their children’s, to his obsession with leading the world’s best marching band, whatever the cost.

title: Echoes
overview: A boy is stuck in a lunchtime detention. He sits in the room listening to his teacher devour a sandwich. He asks to go to the toilet and as he seems to be stuck in the same hallway his worlds start to collide and past and present fall into eachother

title: Listen to the Land Speak
overview: Listen to the Land Speak sees Manchán Magan – one of our most acclaimed writers on landscapes and language – reveal the profound knowledge and wisdom contained in our landscape and myths. Filmed over four seasons, the film unfolds from Winter Solstice to Bealtaine through Reek Sunday to Samhain, exploring how the stories and myths associated with the rivers, mountains, and lands around us are crucial to unlocking aspects of how we need to rebuild our relationship with nature today. It also becomes an unexpectedly personal story – as he seeks to help heal society's relationship with nature. Manchán also realises that there is a serious illness within himself that makes him see these ancient sites and beliefs in a whole new light.

title: A Man with Sole: The Impact of Kenneth Cole
original_title: A Man with Sole: The Impact of Kenneth Cole
overview: With heart & ‘sole’ and unflinching determination, global fashion icon/social activist Kenneth Cole has put ’cause’ before ‘commerce’ for 40 years. Kenneth’s commitment to HIV AIDS, homelessness, LGBTQIA+ rights, social justice and mental health, has shattered stigmas, ignited social awareness, given voice to the voiceless, built coalitions and inspired action for good.

title: LT's Theory of Pets
overview: A husband, L.T., believes his marriage problems stem from the pets his wife and he acquired. He argues that his wife's dog favors her, while his cat prefers him, creating a dysfunctional dynamic that ultimately leads to her leaving him.

title: Hide and Seek
overview: Kyle, a 17-year-old high school student, defies his father’s expectation and classmate’s perspective through dance.

title: Sobre las olas
overview: On an imaginary island, Gloria Zamora, a working mother, unleashes her true nature as money and power enter her life, bringing an entire town under her control. Her daughter, Trinidad, narrates the story, judging her mother’s malice through her inner monologue. Meanwhile, in Spain, actress Rocío Aldama, embodying Sara Montiel, chases her dream of success, as two worlds intertwine in a web of coincidences and misfortunes.

title: Make it Look Real
overview: Intimacy coordinator Claire Warden guides actors through sex scenes on a film set, negotiating the vision of a director, the physical and psychological needs of the performers, and a documentary crew filming her every move.

title: The Dells
overview: At Wisconsin Dells, the world capital of water parks, foreign students are employed on summer work visas. This programme, presented as an immersion into American culture, is also a way of profiting from cheap labour. An inspired portrait of contemporary America through the eyes of this young generation.

title: Oasisdefinitely
overview: Charts the Mancunian rock band's journey from their early days to their debut world tour.

title: Destortion
overview: Destortion is comprised of stock videos and stock images to tell a very interesting story. Destortion reveals the beauty thats seen in nature and the cruelty brought down by dystopia.

title: Snah Morfar: Over Before It Began
original_title: Snah Morfar: Over Før Det Begynte
overview: A "beneath the surface" look at the story of the band Snah Morfar, how it came to be, and how it all fell apart before it even began. Through one-on-one interviews with each member of the band, and statements made by people from the same circle, this is the real story of Snah Morfar.

title: Flor de Calli
overview: After being caught by her husband dancing with another woman, Carolina is hospitalized and forcibly subjected to an invasive procedure, completely losing her autonomy.

title: The Night
overview: Walking through the night. A movie with no dialogues, just sounds from the enviroment.

title: The Birth of a Mohawk
overview: Pressured into strict classical music studies, Vakarė, a teenager, attempts to break free from a controlling mother and find self-identity. Vakarė secretly begins to search for self-expression and freedom, both in her everyday choices and in her relationships with her father and new acquaintances. A newly met strange worldview and symbolic objects nudge Vakarė to question her desires and true nature. A skilled pianist facing strong expectations, Vakarė reveals her independent voice.

title: Matriarch: The Margaret Ann Taylor Hines Story
original_title: Matriarch: The Margaret Ann Taylor Hines Story
overview: A gripping documentary about the life of Margaret Ann Taylor Hines—the iconic matriarch of the Hines family—told in her own words and rendered by her adoring granddaughters.

title: What Follows Is Silence
overview: A quiet boy, full of thoughts, leaves his house holding a toy airplane. He boards a bus and, while playing with the model, arrives at Parco Perotti in Bari, where the memorial stele for Tuninter Flight 1153 stands — a flight that departed from Bari and ditched off the coast of Sicily, near Capo Gallo, on August 6, 2005, causing 16 deaths and deeply affecting the lives of 23 survivors.

title: Stolen Lives
overview: The lives of Sunny Jacobs and Peter Pringle were torn apart when they were wrongly convicted of killing police officers—Sunny in the U.S, Peter in Ireland. Each were jailed for crimes they did not commit, only be exonerated after more than a decade each behind bar. In the aftermath of unimaginable hardship, by chance, they found one another and became the world’s only wrongfully convicted, death sentenced, cop-killer accused, exonerated and married couple!

title: Shelly's Leg
overview: In 1970, an eccentric young stripper named Shelly Baumann loses her leg in a freak parade canon accident, then uses her settlement money to open 'Shelly's Leg' disco - one of the nation's first and most consequential openly gay spaces.

title: The Genius' sister
overview: Hven 1588 – Sophie pursues a career in science but must break free from her brother's all-consuming ego. Over one fateful night at her brother's decadent lunar eclipse party, Sophie struggles to choose her own path in the world.

title: Unravel — Tokyo Ghoul Animation 10th Anniversary
overview: To commemorate the 10th anniversary of the Tokyo Ghoul TV anime, a special collaboration music video featuring "unravel" has been released! Enjoy a re-edited version of the anime that follows the path of Kaneki Ken.

title: The Death Molester's Barn of Blood
original_title: The Death Molester's Barn of Blood
overview: Two cretinous brothers begin to suspect that their cousin is a prolific necrophiliac who has been terrorizing graveyards across the state of Maine.

title: Leo
overview: It’s prom night, and Leo Walker is alone in his room, spiraling into chaos as he tries to make himself picture-perfect. His nerves take over, turning every attempt into a comical disaster. In this genre-bending short, we’re thrown into the frenzied mind of a teenager under pressure, capturing the messy, emotional whirlwind of what’s supposed to be the most important night of his high school life.

title: Charge
overview: Charge is ultimately an investigation of light as a source to transform the future.

title: Sin Eater
overview: When Minerva goes to her grandmothers house to clean it out after she passes,  the intrusion of a stranger forces Minerva to learn there was more to her grandmother than she could have ever known.

title: Amor Dormit
overview: A long-absent father, exiled by the Spanish Civil War, announces his return in a letter that unsettles the fragile bond between mother and daughter — stirring reflections on freedom, fear, and love as they await his arrival.

title: My Next Guest
overview: An awkward high school student named Jimmy pretends to be a talk show host to socialize with people. Can he maintain his persona after asking out Chloe, the captain of the volleyball team?

title: Je veux danser
overview: After five years in Paris, Stefan returns to Mayenne on vacation and meets up with his childhood friend, Benjamin. How do you talk to the girl of your dreams? Together, the two boys explore the subtle art of seduction, right up to the girl in the cherry tree.

title: Mazend
overview: A Film by Biruk Tefera (Barok DZ)

title: El monaguillo, el cura y el jardinero
original_title: El monaguillo, el cura y el jardinero
overview: An altar boy and a gardener decide to break a long and painful silence by denouncing the Catholic priest who abused them as minors. This unprecedented incident in Costa Rica causes the priest to flee, becoming a fugitive from the law and Interpol. The young people unite to find him. Will justice be served this time?

title: Blood Sisters
overview: Summer is invited to a sleepover with a new group of friends, but when their makeover starts to take a dark turn, Summer is tested just how far she will go to fit in.

title: Smells Like Green Spirit the Movie
original_title: 劇場版　スメルズ ライク グリーン スピリット
overview: This is a coming-of-age story set in a closed-off rural area in the Heisei era, depicting the summer spent by Mishima Futoshi, who has just realized his identity, and the boys around him. Mishima, who was bullied by his classmate Kirino Makoto, made it a daily habit to secretly apply lipstick and wear women's clothes. One day, he witnesses Kirino trying to apply lipstick to his lips that he had lost.

title: A Sip of Irish
overview: Celebrating the incredible story of Ireland's contribution to the culinary and drinks world with some unexpected discoveries along the way. It is a humorous look at the likes of Guinness, Hennessy Cognac, Irish whiskey, Muff Liquor Co and Baileys Irish Cream and how they complement Irish cuisine.

title: TEAR
overview: An agent that wears a suit and tie with shorts, must investigate a threat in the building.

title: Baa-Baa!
overview: A family that just moved to their new city apartment, has to figure out what to do with a goat that was suddenly gifted as part of a charity program.

title: The Happy Ending for Sera
overview: Sera glances into the silhouette of 'The one who died standing on the brick wall.' Detectives are tongue-in-cheek, calling it a bizarre case, and Pil-joong, who works in the film industry together, spreads trivial rumors and adds that he doesn't know why he committed suicide unfairly. Sera asks "Would it have been less unfair if you killed at least one person?" unravels the inner side of a character full of resentment, anger, and 'han' in a black comedy way.

title: The Stillness
overview: A lone survivor of the Mortuus Strain outbreak scavenges his new reality, narrowly escaping the infected casualties still walking the earth.

title: Final Call
overview: Hsiao Le tries to reconcile with her friend by inviting her to fulfill their old promise to set off fireworks at the summit of a mountain. Through their conversation, she realizes that the changes in their lives are irretrievable, forcing her to confront the reality of their altered relationship.

title: James Marriott - TRNSMT 2025
overview: A live performance by Brighton based indie-pop artist James Marriott, filmed at TRNSMT Festival 2025 on Glasgow Green and broadcast in full by BBC Scotland on iPlayer.

title: La Piel
overview: Time advances and leaves traces, in the bodies, in memory, in the cinema. A child grows up in an uncertain world, while his father, camera in hand, tries to capture that moment and build a bridge to the future. Between fragments of life, reflections and farewells, the question arises: how to raise a child in a time marked by collapse? Far from the noise of the city, looking for another way to inhabit the world, the director receives a visit from his father, a man who once lived in cinema and now carries the fragility of the years. Between grandfather and grandson, the director discovers himself in transit: still a son, now a father. The skin is a portrait of love as a refuge, of memory as an anchor and of cinema as a witness.

title: Circo
overview: In Rio de Janeiro, Richard dreams of dazzling audiences in the world’s biggest circus tents. But when the 20-year-old artist is kicked out of his home by his adoptive mother, his life is turned upside down. Through an intimate, direct cinema approach, Circo immerses us in the lives of residents of Brazil’s favelas as they seek to shape their own futures.

title: The Cannibal Girl
original_title: カニバさん・異端の純愛
overview: Tamako, a girl suffering from anorexia, falls in love with Yōko, a female photographer who shares the same struggle. The two plan to die together in a double suicide. However, just before doing so, Yōko confesses, “The truth is… I can’t stop wanting to eat you.” And thus begins a twisted ritual of love, filled with terror…

title: JUNK WORLD
overview: Follow up to Junk Head.

title: When the house lights come on
original_title: Abutan man tayo ng house lights
overview: In 2044, a middle-aged gay man finds himself ageing out of the Manila rave scene. A chance encounter with a mischievous ex-lover changes the tune of his last dance.

title: Glasses
overview: Yujin breaks her glasses and visits an optician. During an eye exam, she sees a house in a field and finds herself inside. There, she meets three shadow selves, reconciles with them, and gains a new perspective. Finally, she leaves the house and gets new glasses.

title: Pride Speeches 25'
overview: Bruna Linzmeyer and Milton Cunha use humor to portray situations in the LGBTQIA+ community, reflecting on diversity in a light and amusing way.

title: Moscow Shadows
overview: This is the story of an artist who makes an experimental film, knowing that it goes against all the rules of the film industry. His film is about a young girl who wanders around Moscow with a gun in her purse, looking for UFOs, and his style of storytelling is unacceptable to modern society. How can an artist make an avant-garde film for the film market, knowing in advance that the market does not want it?

title: Small Town Fiction
overview: After his grandmother's funeral, Paulinho returns to his hometown. A misunderstanding sets him on a journey to find a lost photography.

title: Donuts
overview: Scored by Detroit hip-hop legend J Dilla and produced by Junk Food Dinner, DONUTS is a visual essay about xenochrony, circles, and very long telephone cords.

title: Central
overview: The story is about the hero who comes to Chennai Central from a small village due to his family situation, what kind of hardships does he experience in the name of capitalism and how does he recover from it.

title: Inside the Jesus Army
overview: It began as a dream of community life, but a 1970s Christian commune soon became a nightmare of abuse, the scale of which is only just coming to light.

title: Ori Rebirth
overview: Tormented by dark nightmares and shrouded in a forgotten past, a woman embarks on a perilous journey to unlock her true potential and reclaim the heritage that's hers.

title: it is now tomorrow
overview: The different ways a single Vietnamese mother loved her three daughters comes to fruition when Junie, the middle child, reunites with her sisters in their childhood home on their mother’s death anniversary.

title: NICE
overview: A man fights his inner demons to the tune of "Wouldn't It Be Nice" by the Beach Boys

title: Hypnosis Lacking Diagnosis
overview: A man experiences a bizarre drive home from the park after believing he is being followed by a sentient Tennis ball. A Techno based experimental short that is inspired by Noir visuals.

title: Coltan
overview: Based on the contemporary exploitation of coltan, a strategic mineral, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a testimonial and reflexive weaving between the archives of the colonial past and the present of its consequences and resurgences.

title: Tomorrow's Too Late
overview: A singer’s voice—and identity—evolve in this raw, lyrical journey through gender transition, loss, and self-discovery. British artist Dylan Holloway, formerly known as Lots Holloway, stepped away from the spotlight during the 2020 lockdown to begin his gender transition. Once a rising star on the UK’s X-Factor, Dylan now faces a profound personal and professional crossroads: hormone therapy could irreversibly change the voice that once defined his career. Blending candid video diaries, family footage, and intimate interviews, Tomorrow’s Too Late traces Dylan’s early life, his struggle with identity, and the emotional toll of life lived in public. At once a music documentary and a deeply moving portrait of trans experience, the film captures the courage it takes to risk everything in pursuit of an authentic self.

title: Salt of the Earth
overview: In the aftermath of a global collapse, a police officer and his crime boss sister navigate a dystopian world in search of his rabies-infected son.

title: Reunion
overview: A man happens to run into an old acquaintance from high school while on a hike in the woods.

title: Oxygen
overview: Anat, a single mother and a devoted literature primary school teacher, is impatiently waiting for her son’s discharge from the army. But exactly on the due date of his release, a soldier is kidnapped and a new war breaks out. The condition of her shell-shocked father, Ya'akov, starts to deteriorate as Ido calls to say that all discharges have been put on hold. The angst-ridden Anat tries to get him back home, appealing to the kindness of the commanding officers. Ido returns, but her spirit is broken when she discovers that discharges were not suspended - it was he who volunteered to fight. Their symbiotic relationship goes downhill, Ido returns to the border post and the battle flares up. Before his unit enters Lebanon, Anat, who feels trapped between her father and her son, decides to take matters into her own hands.

title: Temps mort: la resurrecció de Charles Thomas
original_title: Temps mort: la resurrecció de Charles Thomas

title: Operation: Sunrise
overview: When a team of elite vampire hunters is ambushed during a routine raid, their leader, Jesse Ross, must join forces with a now reclusive Dr. John Basil to survive the night and stop Paliematch Finnegan Vornak III — an ancient vampire queen determined to plunge the world into eternal darkness — before sunrise becomes a myth.

title: The Sadness is Not Over Yet
original_title: The Sadness is Not Over Yet
overview: Sulastri, a single mother who has to continue her life after a divorce. She faced public pressure over his new status. She was also considered a disgrace to the family because she never remarried.

title: HANDS
overview: As Will and Nathan reflect on their first sexual experience together, a hidden trauma threatens to destroy their blossoming relationship and alter their lives forever. At the core of the story, this film is about the unspoken trauma and miscommunication that lies beneath the surface, which is what makes it so universal. Everyone, no matter sexual orientation, gender identity, race, religion, creed, etc., has gone through some sort of trauma that sticks with us, influencing our decisions and choices in friends and partners, but also inevitably creeps its way into influencing our everyday relationships.

title: Mukoubuchi 4: High Stakes Mahjong Legend – Mahjong Parlor Killer
original_title: むこうぶち4 高レート裏麻雀列伝 雀荘殺し
overview: A pair of Kansai-region underground mahjong hustlers begin storming Tokyo’s local mahjong parlors, scamming unsuspecting players with clever cheating techniques.  One of their victims, Yasunaga Ban (played by pro-wrestler Takada Nobuhiko), is the owner of a mahjong parlor. Seeking revenge, he challenges them to a high-stakes match—but loses. As he's about to give up, a mysterious and feared man known only as “The Outsider” (Mukoubuchi), KAI (played by Yoshihiko Hakamada), enters the scene.  Kai immediately sees through the Kansai duo's tricks and defeats them without mercy. However, a larger threat looms when a powerful figure from Kansai, Katsuta, comes to Tokyo, escalating the conflict to a new level of tension.

title: Mighty Indeed
overview: In one of the harshest places on Earth, three women from different generations chase a hidden and ephemeral world beneath the Antarctic sea ice. Dr Natalie Robinson leads a world-first expedition to McMurdo Sound, joined by microbiologist Jacqui Stuart on her first trip south. Mentoring them from afar is veteran sea ice physicist Professor Pat Langhorne.

title: This Is Jan
overview: Set in the conservative world of the 1950s, Jan checks into a hotel seeking to escape the outside world. Once alone, they are free to shed the identity society has imposed upon them. Jan embraces the chance to explore who they truly believe they are. As they relish this new identity, a surge of confidence emerges, but they soon realize that not everything is as it seems. Faced with a choice between internal pressures and embracing their authentic self, Jan takes a bold step forward.

title: For Your Sake
overview: Zulma is a teenager growing in a rural town and assuming the mandates her family and religious community impose on her, until something happens that prompts her to take the reigns of her own destiny.

title: Ultraman Omega Preview Special
overview: From a mysterious cyber realm comes Pag, the digital life form! Pag's here to give you the inside scoop on the secrets of the upcoming Ultraman Omega! Plus, Pag will be showcasing Ultra Heroes and kaiju from other universes, and the humans who fight alongside them. Let's all get hyped for Ultraman Omega!

title: What Are You Waiting For? Go For It
overview: A principled, exemplary Ward Chairman, who has spent his life sacrificing for his family, retires but refuses to settle down—harboring a youthful dream of running a mobile tattoo truck. With no support from his loved ones, he leaves home and fatefully crosses paths with a reckless, hot-headed Gen Z tattoo artist. Despite their vast generational and personality differences, can this unlikely duo turn their shared passion into something meaningful?

title: Electric Relaxation
overview: A young woman commutes home from work and practices a new form of meditation, utilizing a virtual reality (VR) headset ​​with the capabilities of reading and converting user's thoughts into palpable visuals.

title: Complô
overview: Orphan of the country where he was born, orphan of the Portuguese state. Imprisoned for half his life, never free. Bruno is ‘Ghoya’, a Cape Verdean Creole rapper and political activist. This film is a crossroads in a moment of struggle and life.

title: Next Life
overview: A father dies; his family cares for the deceased and prepares him for his next life. The American setting and way of life intertwine with Buddhist beliefs and customs in a Tibetan family exiled in the United States.

title: Isla's Way
overview: Formidable grandmother Isla Roberts is adamant. She insists that although she’s not a lesbian, her girlfriend Susan is. In this tender, richly humorous portrait of an 87-year-old horse carriage driving champion, we learn what makes an ordinary life extraordinary. Straight-shooting Isla’s lived experience of rural Australia, raising a family in severe economic hardship, and finally coming out later in life, all make for a poignant documentary of a woman who’s well ahead of her time and refuses to be put in a box. Director Marion Pilowsky tracks Isla for an eventful, cathartic year with empathy and incisiveness.

title: Arrivederci tristezza
overview: Aldo, recently turned 40, is left out of the blue and without explanation by Alessia after a 15-year relationship. On the advice of a friend, Aldo decides to begin a course of therapy. During the sessions, his psychologist Carlo, a 70-year-old introvert, discovers that he has had the same experience that prompted Aldo to turn to him.

title: TWO OF US
overview: An individual gets hunted down by their alternate.

title: Bestiary
overview: In a film about monsters, an actor’s greatest enemy is his own grief, a beast that grows stronger with every scene.

title: 34 Days in 2018
overview: 13-year-old Anderson Cefola documents his month-long grounding in 2018 with an old handheld camera he kept.

title: My Dead Dad's Funeral
overview: Riley needs to spread her estranged father’s ashes at his childhood home, but her dark day takes a bizarre turn.

title: Offscreen, the Shadows
overview: A writer, a filmmaker, a trip to Italy: a diary in two voices, where the desire and the difficulty of love are intertwined with literature, cinema, landscapes and the pink stones of the spaces to inhabit.

title: Stardom in Matsue 2025
original_title: STARDOM in MATSUE 2025 〜鹿島沙希凱旋〜
overview: Stardom in Matsue 2025 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom. The event took place on June 28, 2025, with the venue being Matsue City General Gymnasium in Matsue, Shimane. It served as a homecoming show for Saki Kashima.

title: Blue Gun
overview: Wracked with guilt, a former hitwoman tries to erase her past, no matter the cost.

title: Killer Talent
overview: A struggling actress lets her desperation get the better of her with deadly consequences.

title: Jalso: A Family Invitation
overview: Aastha returns to Gujarat for a wedding and falls for Arpan. Their engagement is disrupted when someone from her past appears. Faith in Dwarkadhishji guides her through family bonds and love's challenges.

title: Ballooming
overview: A surrealist tale of love, masculinity, and the pursuit of happiness, which follows the journey of a young man who tries to fix his life in all the ways that don’t work.

title: Black
overview: A man and a woman are following events on the road.

title: Iravu Paravai
overview: A woman who came to Tamil Nadu as a refugee from Sri Lanka and came to Tamil Nadu as a refugee of Indian origin is leading a solo protest in Tamil Nadu. The gist of this story is to bring to the attention of the Central Government through the Chief Minister and Governor of Tamil Nadu with the support of the people of Tamil Nadu and get citizenship of India.

title: Faceless
overview: Experience three parallel lives of an Indigenous man in Naarm (Melbourne) – in each instance, we ponder if he will always be made to feel like an outsider in his own land.

title: Karaoke Nights
overview: A documentary about what karaoke means to three very different college students from across Ireland.

title: Blue Has No Borders
overview: A young filmmaker is determined to know her neighbours in the port town of Folkestone. But in the aftermath of Brexit, building new relationships isn’t easy.

title: Montreal-Nord: A Place to Dream
overview: From the streets of Montréal-North to becoming a defensive force in the NBA with The Oklahoma City Thunder, basketball has been Luguentz Dort's lifelong journey. His Haitian roots, the grit of Parc Saint-Laurent, the founding of Maizon Dort  and the unwavering spirit of his community have shaped him into everything he is today.

title: Babo Lo Sekrab
overview: Babo Lo, a dangerous gang leader, disguises himself as a Bangladeshi junk dealer, modeling himself after crime legend Pablo Escobar.

title: Like It Was
overview: A bitter couple has one last chance to talk, and one last chance to make things right.

title: VIRTUOSO
overview: Liszt, the extravagant and virtuoso Hungarian pianist, performs one of his pieces in the Budapest Opera House, breaking the codes of classical performance.

title: Seribu Bayang Purnama
overview: Putro Purnama returned to his village after being discouraged from pursuing his hopes and dreams in the city. Determined to start a new life and dreams of revitalizing his family's land through natural farming methods. However, plans quickly resolve the resistance when his family's old rival challenges him to a prestigious farming competition. These battles can determine who will gain influence over the villagers.  As Putro struggles to prove the value of sustainable natural farming, his journey becomes more complicated when he falls in love with Ratih, the owner of the village's chemical fertilizer and pesticide shop, the daughter of his family's rival. Caught between his ideals and feelings, Putro struggles to bring meaningful change to society while facing personal and social conflicts. His determination to improve the lives of those he loves is tested at every turn, forcing him to face challenges deeper than his dreams.

title: Kein Land für Niemand - Abschottung eines Einwanderungslandes
original_title: Kein Land für Niemand - Abschottung eines Einwanderungslandes

title: Circle of Life
overview: A historical saga set during World War II, when Japan was at war with China. A veterinarian flees to Inner Mongolia after his wife and son are killed by the Japanese. He helps a woman who is unable to give birth because her child is important to the tribe, and begins to heal from his loss.

title: The Dancer
overview: For Ahmad Joudeh, a stateless refugee from Syria, dance is not a choice, it’s a lifeline – etched onto his very skin with the words “Dance or Die.” Having defied war and family disapproval to join the Dutch National Ballet, Ahmad found sanctuary in the Netherlands, becoming a UNHCR and LGBTQI+ Ambassador. But haunted by the trauma of his past, he makes a perilous decision: to return to Syria for the first time since the war, risking everything to bring the healing power of dance to a community still ravaged by conflict.

title: The Voice of God
overview: With the rise of Neo-Pentecostalism in Brazil over the past decade, a popular phenomenon has emerged, taking over church pulpits and smartphone screens: religious preaching by children. Immersing himself in the family lives and faith of two young pastors from different generations, Antunes Ramos (director of “A Flecha e a Farda”, Olhar ’20) unveils the childhoods and youth behind their public personas, while offering glimpses into a country where politics and religion often intertwine.

title: Two in One: The Briscoe Story
original_title: Two in One: The Briscoe Story
overview: Mark Briscoe and the Pugh family share the story of how The Briscoe brothers built a dynasty over a 20+ year career filled with barbed wire, love, and tragedy.

title: Childhood
overview: A former child soldier living in Ireland reckons with his trauma as his son reaches the age he was when he was first captured.

title: The Scent of Things Remembered
original_title: A Memória do Cheiro das Coisas
overview: An intimate drama about an aging war veteran forced into a retirement home, where he confronts the ghosts of his past and forms an unexpected bond with his Black caregiver.

title: Chanel No. 2
overview: In a single night of debauchery and chaos, a group of young party-goers embark on a journey to the club, but for Chanel, the night becomes a search for something she can't name. As the line between freedom and self-destruction blurs among the neon lights of the city, Chanel falls further from who she used to be.

title: Divia
overview: The film explores the catastrophic influence of Russian invasion on nature in Ukraine. This is a journey from the harmonious life of nature to the fiery whirl of war which burns out the earth, forests and all flesh. As the spring comes, nature revives and brings new life among animals despite the irreversible damage. Yet the tremendous scope of the tragedy deprives us of hope for immediate natural recovery and cleaning of the remains of war.

title: Hellminta
overview: HELLMINTA is the end, HELLMINTA is the beginning; The cycle repeats itself again and again; Thea is hungry and Ethan is meat, and she needs more and more; She's a maneater.

title: The Juice of Evil
overview: Drag icon Nina Queer sends the aging disco diva Anastasia Palmovsky on a bloody escape from the youth welfare office, grandma Brunhilde - and her own demons. Also starring: Magda von Pfeffer, Tatjana Berlin, Jürgen Vogel, Ingo Raabe, Rolf Scheider and many more.

title: Е***и тъпия виц
overview: A hungover guy trying to tell a joke... that he doesn't remember.

title: The Guardian
overview: Khmer horror film.

title: Not My Sister
overview: Maeve finds herself questioning if her sister really is her sister and if not... who or what is it?

title: VUD, YOU WON
overview: The rise and fall of Yugoslavian filmmaker Dušan Vukotić - the only Yugoslav Oscar-winner and one of the founding members of the Zagreb School of Animation - uncannily mirrors the tragic fate of his multiethnic country.

title: Playing with Fire: An Ecosexual Emergency
original_title: Playing with Fire: An Ecosexual Emergency
overview: From the creators of the first queer environmental documentary feature films comes a hot new offering. The third chapter is their most epic and daring yet — fusing art, activism, and intimate storytelling in a touching journey through crisis, change, and renewal. When a firestorm rips through their redwood forest home, two artist-activists — Beth Stephens & Annie Sprinkle —emerge with a powerful message of love, resilience, and ecological hope, guided by a relationship with their magical peacock.

title: Girlfriend Girlfriend
overview: "Holy homophobia Batwoman, we better use the scissor symbol to assemble the team!"  A queer woman's mind is blown by her new coworker's bold question in this experimental short film.

title: Not your valentine
overview: Not your valentine is a short story with interweaving narratives of two thieves trying to escape a robbery gone wrong and a couple fighting on valentines day, this was scripted, shot and edited in 3 hours

title: From the Start || Animated MV
overview: It tells the story of Ahri, a girl who has a crush on a classmate, in a world where their relationship isn’t accepted. Unofficial music video for the song "From The Start" by Good Kid.

title: Rent Boy
overview: Driven by ambitions of being a concert pianist, a young sex worker violates a client's privacy, triggering unexpected consequences.

title: Being You
overview: A reserved screenwriter sits in the middle of a press interview when a question about her past triggers a panic attack, causing her to faint. She wakes up and realizes she has traveled back in time to meet her outspoken younger self and must convince her not to make the mistake she has regretted for most of her life.

title: Sweat It Out!
overview: SWEAT IT OUT! charts the rise and fall of the iconic Australian music scene, affectionately dubbed ‘Oz Rock’.  It’s the story of ambition, power and passion. Of the bands that succeeded, and those that didn’t.  It’s a tale of oversized, colourful characters who risked it all – and the legion of fans who joined them on their journey, sweating it out in the tiny inner urban pubs, massive outer suburban beer barns and jampacked provincial hotels.  It’s the story of a country forging its identity through music and an ethos of bands that toured longer, drove further and played harder to be heard. When bands would play live seven nights a week, sometimes playing three gigs in one day – sometimes even playing three gigs, in three different states, in the one day!

title: Princess Mimi and King of Penis
overview: 'Princess Mimi' and 'King of Penis' plan to die together. But their wish for a painless death is soon disrupted by a series of unexpected events.

title: Magnus the Magnificent
overview: When Glenn's girlfriend leaves him for a cape-wearing hypnotist, Glenn knows that it couldn't have been his fault; she must have been hypnotized.

title: Cinema Jazireh
overview: Afghanistan under the brutal rule of the Taliban. After surviving her family’s massacre, Leila has just one goal in life: to find her son Omid. But in a country where being a woman means being less than nothing, her chances are desperately slim, and so she chooses an extreme and dangerous solution. She radically changes her identity and sets out on a path where even the slightest hesitation can mean death.

title: Waiting for You to Return
overview: Two left-behind boys: Hai Ri and Chao Lu grow up on the grasslands of Inner Mongolia. After facing family tragedies, his father’s death, mother’s illness, and grandmother’s breakdown; Hai Ri becomes distant. Arriving at his grandfather’s home, he meets Chao Lu, a kind-hearted Mongolian peer. Through shared hardship, their initial conflict evolves into deep friendship. Hai Ri matures from timid to brave, learning to protect and care. Together, they forge a bond of mutual support, reflecting themes of resilience, friendship, and the power of familial love.

title: J-POP: Vocaloid Goes Global
overview: Japan's Vocaloid culture is currently experiencing a boom in popularity worldwide. We examine why people are drawn to the voice synthesis technology and the artists that emerged from this culture.

title: A Film About Toby
overview: Toby lives a pretty normal life...that is, until he realizes he's trapped inside a film. What's worse? It's a student film.

title: Shadows of the Moon
overview: A short film by Tina Velickovikj.

title: The Hidden Sauna Association of Ursviken
overview: One day, everyday life is turned upside down, when a hideous monster arrives in the village, whose goal is to turn the Sauna Warriors' sauna into a dumping ground for filthy glowfarts.

title: A Whale Can Be Torn Apart Like a Samba School
original_title: Uma Baleia Pode Ser Dilacerada Como Uma Escola De Samba
overview: It’s Carnival in Rio. A young man wanders through the streets of the city and the remains of the huge cardboard parade floats. Driven by grief over the bankruptcy of his samba school, he’s also haunted by memories of his dead father and a lost love. An impressive cinematic experiment composed of fragments of the present and the past, developed as part cinema, part art installation in the tropical setting of Rio.

title: PIEOWA: A Piece of America
overview: PIEOWA: A PIECE OF AMERICA celebrates the myriad ways pie is woven into Iowa’s culture, the lengths people will go to for a slice, and how this humble pastry can bake the world a better place.

title: De Matadero A Vivero
overview: De Matadero A Vivero is an audiovisual piece by the artist Fernando Sánchez Castillo that covers the hundred-year history of the building of Matadero Madrid, from its inauguration in 1924 to the current moment as a cultural container, through the Civil War, the post-war and other moments of disuse. The project arises as a commission from the Center for Artistic Residences of Matadero within the framework of the celebration of the Centenary and is based on historical documentation, dialogues with historians, sociologists and people who have been linked to this space in its different stages.

title: Jangar
overview: A man arrives on an island to escape a troubled past and battles a vengeful antagonist who follows him there.

title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Elephant
overview: Ollie lives in a busy city with her parents and half-sister Nim, who has Down’s syndrome. While Ollie loves Nim, it often feels like a responsibility. At their grandmother Antje’s 75th birthday, they plan to perform Nim’s favorite song. When Nim panics about her forgotten elephant headband, she runs into the woods, and Ollie chases her. They get lost but face enchanting challenges together.

title: The Sight Unseen
overview: In 1971, Sharon witnessed a glowing cross in her Bronx apartment, sparking belief and skepticism. "The Sight Unseen" explores her memories and Melvin Tapley’s writings, investigating whether the phenomenon was divine or a hoax.

title: Interruption
overview: This experimental short film references its predecessor, "Colors," but now brings with it the discomfort and strangeness that comes from addiction; it all revolves around the switch. But a masked creature appears out of nowhere, and it wants to settle the score with whoever is under the switch's control.

title: 22 Minutes
overview: Seojin lives with her mom, but they only see each other for about 10 minutes after Seojin returns from work in the morning. One seemingly ordinary day, everything changes when the emergency siren goes off. Suddenly, residents in the Seoul area are instructed to take shelter immediately. Though they live together, Seojin and her mom have rarely truly shared their lives — until now, as they begin to make an evacuation plan.

title: Kum Zambağı
overview: Yunus is deeply in love with Afife, whom he has waited for years and cherishes as if she were sacred. After enduring abuse from her former husband, Afife seeks a new home and proposes a contractual marriage to Yunus. As part of the agreement, Yunus will not force Afife to love him; in return, Afife will live under the same roof, by Yunus' side. Will Yunus and Afife be able to uphold this agreement?

title: The Birds Shall Return
overview: The Birds Shall Return is a documentary narrated by grandmothers and third-generation Palestinians from Jordan and the Netherlands. Their intimate testimonies show how passing on stories is an act of resistance; From memories of a paradise within arm’s reach, to the harsh reality of resisting the occupation of their homeland.

title: Game On
overview: As she creates her 50th game, legendary designer Brenda Romero leads her team through the highs and hurdles of game development, balancing motherhood, leadership, and creativity.

title: The Echos
overview: At a crossroads, a girl decides whether to remain in the past or focus on the future

title: Baby Tooth
overview: Marina has enlisted the help of a stranger to get rid of either her baby tooth, or her boat, whichever he prefers.

title: The Words Women Spoke One Day
original_title: Les Mots Qu'elles Eurent Un Jour
overview: 1962, at the end of the Algerian War, Algerian independence activists are released from Rennes prison. For one night, filmmaker Yann Le Masson films them. They tell him their vision for the future of Algeria and the place women must occupy in the new society to be built. Fifty years later, with the soundtrack missing, Raphaël Pillosio sets out to find these women. Two deaf people set about lip-reading the women filmed by Yann Le Masson, revealing snatches of sentences, words cut short by the camera's shifts. An investigative film in which the few activists still alive discover their old testimonies and tell us their silent story. The reconstruction of the lost soundtrack will remain in suspense; no happy ending will come to absorb the absence, to cancel the ferocious operation of time. An essay film about cinema that depicts their disappearance, and forever keeps them alive.

title: Who Killed Henrique Ruas
overview: After a murder shocks the academic community of the Federal University of Santa Catarina, a group of documentary artists decide to tell this story - but they find out terrible secrets.

title: Rubens Happy World 2
overview: The Sequel to Rubens Happy World.  A film made by Ruben's friends. A present for Ruben.

title: Idrak Mirzalizade: This Never Happened
original_title: Идрак Мирзализаде: Этого никогда не было
overview: A complete chronicle of how Idrak Mirzalizade wanted to film a concert, but everything went terribly wrong.

title: You're Toast
overview:
Aging spy AGENT JONES is determined not to send his protégé, PUGSLEY, onto the field - out of fear of losing her.
 After being sent on a seemingly routine mission, Jones unexpectedly comes face to face with his biggest challenge yet. Can he, against his overwhelming instincts, trust the younger generation of spies to help him so that he can finally find peace.

title: Thawing Seeds: A Forest Fairy Guide from the Underground
original_title: Thawing Seeds: A Forest Fairy Guide from the Underground
overview: You wake up alone in the forest. A fairy finds you and guides you underground - towards the ways of the ants, the roots, and the deep intelligence of the Earth. A poetic and enchanting offering for the frozen, dissociated and forgotten.

title: Velvet Vision: The Story of James Bidgood and the Making of Pink Narcissus
original_title: Velvet Vision: The Story of James Bidgood and the Making of Pink Narcissus
overview: Velvet Vision is a raw and intimate portrait of James Bidgood, the visionary artist behind the cult classic Pink Narcissus, who’s groundbreaking 1960s homoerotic imagery helped redefine queer aesthetics.

title: Mais um Dia
overview: The artist Leonora Maia, another day in the Amazon rainforest.

title: Nightfall: A Paranormal Investigation
overview: The year is 1988. Paranormal investigators Mick Sutherland and Archie Charlesworth have built their careers on confronting the unexplained across Northern Europe. But when a desperate call draws them to the isolated home of Elizabeth Blair, they encounter a presence unlike anything they’ve faced before.  Over seven days, this force begins to unravel their sanity, twisting their perception of reality and threatening to destroy their bond. This is no ordinary haunting. This is Case 13.

title: Vignettes
overview: A Child Lost. A Loved One Gone. A Friend.

title: Let's Eat (,) Seabass
overview: A student, Henry, overhears a fellow classmate, Declan, saying that he wants to eat another class mate named Seabass. Henry decides to take matters into his own hands.

title: Oil Springs
overview: The story will mostly take place in the town Oil Springs, Ontario, where the oil industry in North America was born. By making a case study of this town, we can better understand how the industry operates today. The documentary will explore themes of colonialism, climate change and Canadian identity.

title: I Still Smell You
original_title: Eu Ainda Sinto o Seu Cheiro
overview: A familiar scent leads a college student to confront an intangible presence, forcing him to face the pains of grief.

title: Signed, Pedro Lennon

title: I Am Alive
overview: In the near future, a husband must decide whether to save his wife by fusing her body with an artificial intelligence consciousness, setting off a series of events that unravel the truth about her unsettling past life.

title: Where Roots Go
overview: In a society where witches are hated, Yeongeun has been living in hiding from the outside world with her daughter Roo, who is actually a plant-like monster born from her mother’s creation. Sadly, she decides to undo her daughter’s curse, but Roo ultimately decides to fulfill her true destiny. They go on a personal and emotional journey in which they’ll find a new land, where Roo will take root as a tree.

title: Knucklebones
overview: A compulsive person has to have all his decisions made by the roll of a die.

title: A Bloody Mess

title: Mahabhoj (महाभोज)
overview: Mahabhoj is a social drama set in the backdrop of Nepal’s political system. It tells the story of everyday people who stand up against those who exploit them for selfish interests. The film highlights themes like rebellion, justice, and the struggle against political corruption and social inequality.  At its core, the story follows a bank loan manager in urgent need of money. When he turns to his father for help, he learns that his father’s lifelong savings have been stolen by a corrupt cooperative and a group of greedy individuals. This discovery sets off a powerful journey of resistance and truth.

title: A Quarter Century Tulip
overview: A Dutch-Turkish photographer struggles with a lack of home. In his quest to find his own home, his mother encourages him to give a home to the tulip bulb she gave him.

title: Pas de Deux
overview: A ballet dancer becomes trapped in a battle of wills with a cold, uncaring judge.

title: Across the Aisle
overview: An idealistic congressman attempts to woo his colleague from the other side of the aisle.

title: Mitthe Premer Golpo
overview: Mitthe Premer Golpo is a sad romantic Drama.

title: Sock
overview: When Jerry (30s) masturbates into it one too many times, his crusty old sock comes to life and immediately declares its love for Jerry. This newfound sentience causes a problem when Jerry’s girlfriend Claire demands he throw the disgusting thing away. Sock and Jerry convince Claire to keep Sock around, as Sock promises to help get their relationship back on track. However, once Jerry and Claire begin to resolve their issues and need Sock less, Sock’s jealousy turns to rage and blood-soaked vengeance.

title: Roach
overview: Birth, Death, & Marriage: the milestones of life that we all hope to meet with temperance and grace. Unfortunately for most of us, however, we arrive at these checkpoints snot-nosed, nauseated and, more often than not, covered in our own shit.

title: Il Kapitano: Una dedica a Francesco Silvestre
original_title: Il Kapitano: Una dedica a Francesco Silvestre
overview:
Modà is one of the most famous Italian bands of all time, especially thanks to their amazing leader Francesco Silvestre, known as Kekko. This is their story, but most importantly, his story...
 A documetary approved by Kekko Silvestre himself

title: Dead Fish
overview: On a dirt road, two truck driver friends face a mechanical problem and are unexpectedly helped by a woman who lives nearby. She points them to a repair shop, takes them to her home, and their time together unfolds in a mysterious way.

title: Severed
overview: A woman makes an important discovery.

title: Musical Horrifically Funny Women
overview: Seok-gu, a documentary producer specializing in current events and accusations, wishes to find meaning in the dark and inconvenient things of the world. Old women who fell in love with Hangeul (Korean alphabet) appear in front of him. Over and over again, they say "old people should die," but their joyful lives are more exciting than anyone else's.

title: Goti Lo
overview: Goti Lo follows Dadaji's clever plan to reunite his gadget-addicted family in their village. To save their ancestral home, they must win a traditional games challenge - rediscovering real-life bonds, roots, and the joy beyond screens.

title: No Kings Day

title: Immutable

Beginning at an annual summer debate camp during the final days of the COVID pandemic, the film follows a group of dedicated young debaters. They immerse themselves in research, critical thinking, teamwork, and performance, hoping these skills will not only help them win tournaments but also overcome the obstacles standing between them and their full potential.

title: The Fall
overview: When two sisters living in rural Oklahoma are left home alone, Ryan, the elder of the two, tries to sneak away with a couple of boys – but firstly, she needs to find her long forgotten weed, stashed away in the family barn. Blake, feeling left out, is tight on Ryan’s heels, and when the arguing reaches its limit, a devastating accident happens, forcing Blake and Ryan to reconcile their past trauma.

title: Memoirs of Amanda
overview: Amanda’s world was shaped by the harsh echoes of her parents’ criticism, and this shattered her self-esteem as a child. At the age of 74, Amanda is a testament to the transformative power of self-achievement. Defying the odds has led her to set her sights on one final, seemingly insurmountable goal: completing the 109 km Cape Town Cycle Tour for the 23rd time.

title: Killergotchi
overview: Pepa gets the virtual baby of her dreams, but playing mother soon turns into a nightmare.

title: Carmela and the Walkers

title: Turnstile: Live from Glastonbury 2025
overview: Fast becoming one of the world’s biggest rock bands, Turnstile play the Other Stage.

title: North South
overview: A hybrid film story, combining the form of a musical with elements of a music film and a personal documentary. The central character and narrator of the story is Quebo – a renowned artist who disappeared from the scene and now returns to speak about his struggle with bipolar disorder.

title: Fragmentos de um homem frágil
overview: A tragic story of a romantic man.

title: Driver
overview: In a city gripped by fear, a criminal roams free — while Antônio, a quiet ride-share driver trapped in the monotony of his own existence, begins to question the meaning of his life. One night, a mysterious passenger enters his car… leading him down a dark and unpredictable road.

title: Solitary
