As violence touches the community, and trust in the system fades, Brendan must confront what it means to feel safe, to grow old, and to be truly alone.

title: Interval
overview: Carlos, desperate for not receiving a response from his boyfriend, takes a taxi that will take him to various parts of the city to look for him and to find himself through Aurelio, the driver of the vehicle that will transport him in the middle of the night.

title: The Home
overview: A good-humored portrait of the oldest and largest Jewish homes in South Africa as its clients kvetch about companions and battle to elect a new Resident Committee.

title: A Quiet Love
overview: In this intimate film, three Deaf couples share their remarkable love stories through Irish Sign Language: a decades-long forbidden romance across a religious divide, an LGBTQI+ couple navigating parenthood with Deaf and hearing children, and a Deaf boxer and his hearing partner facing a life-altering choice.

title: The Spectacle
overview: The Spectacle is a short reflective documentary that explores the world of modern tourism. Filmed in various locations across Europe, the documentary unveils the transformation of serene landscapes into bustling tourist attractions. What remains truly seen and felt amidst the curated snapshots of our adventures?

title: Mond Appétit
overview: Mond Appétit is the newest film of director Sjoerd de Bont

title: Dream Studio in Madagascar
overview: What kind of dream are three people dreaming of in dreamy and beautiful Madagascar? A photographer who takes passport photos at a small local photo studio but dreams of going to Africa to take family photos. A thirdrate cabaret singer and a street vendor who support his dream. A road movie about three people traveling around Madagascar, Africa, to achieve their own dreams.

title: The Unshakeable Destiny
overview: This playful, expansive trilogy explores the artist’s evolving relationship with Hong Kong as the city undergoes its own upheavals. Reworking the visual language of Asian futurism, some scenes are shot on lush 16mm, immersing viewers in swoony Cantopop and late-night neon; other scenes move away from the nostalgic, stylised world of Wong Kar Wai. Working with actor Ching Ching Ho, Lam deconstructs the fictions of Hong Kong’s screen archive and her own attempts to capture memories of a disappearing homeland. This moving reflection on artmaking in the diaspora draws on collective memories to imagine possible futures.

title: Lamb To The Slaughter
overview: Based on a Roald Dahl Short Story.

title: GRUT / CELL
overview: The Master takes The Vicar on a quest across the Three Kingdoms to destroy the GRUT CELL to stop The EBE and his legion of Gruts.

title: 8 Days
overview: After discovering his girlfriend's betrayal, Ayaan retreats to his aunt's town, where an eight-day journey with his aunt, his friend Banku and a mysterious girl leads to self-discovery.

title: Spiritus: No Business Like Dough Business
original_title: Spiritus: No Business Like Dough Business
overview: Highlighting the rich history of one of the oldest and beloved family-run businesses in Provincetown—Spiritus Pizza is a local gem and iconic late-night gathering spot. Featuring homespun interviews with owner John Yingling and many former employees, SPIRITUS explores the challenges faced by the business, the queer community and the AIDS crisis, all against the backdrop of changing attitudes in the town during the 1970s and ’80s. Since its founding in 1971, and through the ensuing decades, Spiritus has remained a vibrant epicenter of activity, resilience, and deeply-rooted history in Provincetown—as well as a slice of pizza heaven!

title: Little Caribou
overview: "Little Caribou" is an environmentally themed story about a young Inuit sister and brother living inside the Arctic Circle who one day discover some very unusual creatures when an ancient iceberg visits their bay.

title: I Remember You
overview: Inspired by true stories, the movie is set in the scenic island of Boracay where Gani (Santos), a bank employee, is forced to return to the island he left to heal a broken heart. As he begins to create a new life, Debby (Montenegro), his ex, shows up.

title: Raunak
overview: Resilience and destiny shape Raunak's path and keep her spirits up against all odds.

title: No Choice
overview: A young woman becomes unexpectedly pregnant and starts having harrowing, prophetic dreams that she will die if she can't get an abortion.

title: Tulips X Lady Lazarus
overview: Visuals inspired by Tulips and Lady Lazarus by Sylvia Plath.

title: Rundown
overview: Tommy tries to live under his alter ego "Tommy G" after having made a mixtape with his best friend Pelle aka "Little P".

title: The Many Deaths of Nora Dalmasso
original_title: Las Mil Muertes de Nora Dalmasso
overview: A three-part true-crime docuseries about the unsolved 2006 murder of Nora Dalmasso, a wealthy woman found strangled in her home in Río Cuarto, Argentina. The investigation spiraled into a media circus, marked by sensationalism, classism, and misogyny. As suspicions fell on her teenage son Facundo, he became the target of homophobic speculation and was effectively outed in the press, turning the case into a public trial of identity and morality. Her husband was also accused years later but acquitted. The series follows the twists of a flawed investigation, exposes the personal and societal consequences of prejudice, and examines how Nora’s death—and her reputation—were repeatedly violated by the institutions meant to protect justice. Even after new DNA evidence emerges, justice remains elusive due to Argentina’s statute of limitations.

title: Nothing Will Die
overview: Five baby birds are born into a threatening and overwhelming world. As their mother struggles to protect them from merciless predators, the baby birds fight their own battles for her attention. A story of survival, the cycle of life, and hope amidst the unforgiving realities of nature.

title: ALT
overview: The plan of 3 Thieves to loot 10 million cash intercepts with A Lady leaving the town after a murder to do something secret, which all ends up to a mysterious end.

title: You Know You Wanna Stay
overview: A freshman girl sneaks out to counsel her senior friend. His actions make her question the boundaries of "friendship."

title: The Thrilling Adventure of Amos Waters
original_title: The Thrilling Adventure of Amos Waters
overview: The Thrilling Adventure of Amos Waters is the story of a ten-year-old boy, Amos, filled with a childlike curiosity about the world and a craving to understand all aspects of life.  The film follows Amos' journey to understand his single, alcoholic father. He travels to a liquor store armed with his father's ID to buy alcohol, but no matter his determination to present himself as his father, everything keeps going wrong. Eventually, on his way home, he passes by a Sunday mass service and attends service to get drunk on the Communion wine. After tasting alcohol, meeting unlikely friends, and going on the journey of a lifetime, Amos has to decide whether or not he can find contempt in the incomprehension of his father's illness.

title: Alarm Notes
overview: A pioneer in sound recording, Ludwig Koch was suspected by the Nazis of complicity in the Reichstag fire. After taking refuge in England, he specialized in recording birdsong. Blending contemporary imagery with his sound archives, the film retraces his journey.

title: Shubhchintak
overview: Novice Meghna and her two accomplices plot to honey trap Sanjay for revenge, facing humorous and moral challenges. Will she let revenge consume her?

title: Kunitori
overview: In a gentrified near future, the owners of the last sporting club in Lisbon spend one final moment together after learning of its sale.

title: Dissecando Selma
overview: A director starts from a disturbing provocation to explore, in the tone of a fable, the boundaries between motherhood, desire, and identity. At the center is Selma, a mother consumed by jealousy, who spirals into delusions and imagined rivalries after discovering signs of her son's sexual life.

title: That Teen: The Movie
overview: Four teens from around the world step off the path they were told to follow — and take the road less travelled.

title: The Intern
overview: A Minute of Hopeless Intern

title: Dreams in the Attic
overview: Eccentric Aunt Nellie (Shelley Duvall) has a magical trunk in her attic at the costume shop that she owns. Costumes that are placed in the trunk possess the ability to fulfill the "dreams" of those who wear them.

title: Leaving Romero
overview: After 140 years, there are alternatives to an asylum. Leaving Romero closely follows the experience of deinstitutionalization, focusing on the lives of the users and those who are the driving force of this process: the young people who make up the Movement for Deinstitutionalization in Romero.

title: Test Piece
overview: Kersti Jan Werdal’s Test Piece critically examines the art of filmmaking as a synthesis of conceptual construction and intricate editing. Inspired by Straub-Huillet, the film deconstructs the fundamental elements of film, image, sound, and text, to create a space for reflection and thought rather than conventional narrative explanation or emotional immersion.

title: Wolfoo & Cuộc Đua Tam Giới
overview: “Wolfoo & The Three Realms Race” marks the cinematic debut of Wolfoo, the Vietnamese animated IP and YouTube phenomenon with billions of views and global reach in 181 countries. In this high-quality animated adventure, Wolfoo and his father Wulfen are swept from their peaceful home in Neverland into an epic race across the mystical Three Realms to stop Lord Idra’s wrath from destroying their world. Guided by Ali the 500-year-old cat racer, the father-son duo faces thrilling challenges, uncovers the secrets of a forbidden Outer Realm, and learns timeless lessons about friendship, teamwork, and the bond between father and child.

title: TATTIWIN
overview: The film tells the story of the creation of the first hydroelectric power stations in Morocco — Flilou and Sidi Saïd — which were built by the French company Penarroya to supply electricity to the Ahouli mines. The goal was to facilitate drilling operations for the extraction of lead ore.  It also highlights the village of Tattiwine, located about 12 kilometers from Midelt, which served as the main water source for the Flilou station. Additionally, it covers the Sidi Saïd power station, which was supplied with water by a nearby dam to generate electricity.

title: Girassóis
overview: In a Brazil measured 6×1, Girassóis follows the daily life of Zé, an elderly Black man who is still forced to work. Portraying the harsh reality that burdens Brazilian workers, the story reflects on the challenges of labor—from the daily grind to its impact on family relationships and the fading hopes for a hostile future. Loosely based on true events.

title: A Almadraba Atuneira
overview: The life of tuna fishermen and their families during the fishing season on Pumpkin Island in Tavira (Algarve). The documentary depicts their fishing methods and their return home after fishing. This was the last activity of "frame" or "almadraba" tuna fishery, before the camp was destroyed by the sea in the winter of the following year, in 1962.

title: Autism and the Arts: Poetry with Peter Street
original_title: Autism and the Arts: Poetry with Peter Street
overview: Born in 1948, Peter Street struggled at school with epilepsy and illiteracy in Bolton, Lancashire, and, later in life, as a slaughterman, a gravedigger and a war poet. At 66 years old he was then diagnosed with autism, and his world changed forever.

title: Spiaggia di vetro
overview: Salvo, a Sicilian fisherman, is devastated by the tragic death at sea of his child during a bath at the "glass beach" and to escape the unbearable pain he leaves his village and goes to work far away as a offshore welder on an oil platform. When he receives news of his father’s stroke, he returns to Sicily to sell his father’s house with the idea of using the proceeds to obtain shared custody of his daughter in Calabria. But here his life will change again thanks to the activities of the catwalks that cross the Strait and the presence of people and unexpected affections, in the landscape of the coasts and villages of Messina and Villa San Giovanni.

title: Lane Violation
overview: The film explores Bogut's storied career, from his time growing up in Melbourne, his rise through the University of Utah, and the ups and downs of an NBA career that featured everything from a championship to career-defining injuries. It all culminates in the next phase of Bogut's basketball journey, which will be his first stint on the sidelines, as an assistant coach with the Sydney Kings.  What's unique, though, is that it's a documentary driven by Longley. Bogut visits Longley's large but minimalist, reception-less sanctuary in Denmark, Western Australia -- about a five-hour drive south of Perth -- giving the audience the opportunity to see two of the country's most successful sporting exports in as stripped back an environment that exists in Australia.

title: Show Me the Pain of the World
original_title: Show Me the Pain of the World
overview: Mental illness is a global phenomenon that causes enormous harm not only to individuals, but also to society and the economy. Yet its causes and effects are largely ignored. This documentary fills that gap. Over a period of seven years, researchers from Germany, South Africa, Australia, Slovenia, Japan, and India investigated the socioeconomic causes.

title: Jeff

title: Gun Safety with God
overview: Listen to Pastor Pete as he explains the wonders of gun safety with verses from the Bible. Watch as his sidekicks, Monty Mouse and Sammy Snake, learn these lessons and have fun doing so.

title: Karunrung 1995
overview: In the heat of the traditional market in Makassar City, a gang of thugs led by Uli spread terror and fear. Until one day, a rich businessman, Hendra, offers him a dirty job with big pay, everything turns into a cruel massacre that not only takes lives, but also arouses anger from other realms.  A family of Burhan, Farida, his pregnant wife and their children, were sadistically massacred without mercy and justice was not only sought by the police or an ambitious journalist named Alana, assisted by her lover Andi, but also by the victim's spirit which could not rest. When guilt, fear and supernatural terror begin to haunt the perpetrators, one by one they begin to lose control.

As they move through the city, routine shifts and silence spreads. Based on  Clavel's "Trondheim Is No Game" , the film uses scenes from other works to trace a path through suspicion, disappearance, and unresolved presence.

title: Реальность не нужна. Восточно-сибирский панк
overview: The almanac consists of six short stories dedicated to the key punk rock bands of the Irkutsk region and the Republic of Buryatia, which formed an original musical style and made a cultural contribution to the development of the musical community of Eastern Siberia. Each part is a kind of alternative film chronicle, capturing the history of the Siberian musical underground from the 1990s to the 2000s, as well as a projection of the punk subculture participants to the present day.

title: Salvación

As big as the dream is, there are things in the way of that. Hoping to overcome these obstacles, this trio of teenagers has to navigate their senior year of high school, home lives, relationships, and the good old figuring out what they want to do with their lives. Will that get in the way of their dream?

With the material obtained I put together this film-postcard without sound for Alita, very inspired by Teo Hernandez and Tomonari Nishikawa.

title: Di Sarno: The Story of Emilio’s Ballato
original_title: Di Sarno: The Story of Emilio’s Ballato

title: Crendices

His father, once authoritarian, now weakened, and his grandmother, a mystical figure in the village, represent a world where fear and popular beliefs shape everyday life. While trying to maintain reason in an environment marked by rituals, superstitions and disturbing coincidences, Rafael confronts the past and the possibility that the unusual may be more real than he imagines. Between family drama and dark humor, Crendices is a rural satire where the absurd intersects with everyday life, and where a simple superstition can unleash chaos.

title: Lesbian Custody

As a nearly forgotten period of LGBTQ+ history, this documentary short introduces us to now retired filmmaker Frances Reid (award winning cinematographer and director) and her “step-daughter” Julie Stevens while they look through the film’s archives, discuss the making of the film and their personal relationship.

title: Volatile: Birds of a Feather
overview: In a quiet forest, a lonely dove mourning her lost eggs befriends a stray kitten, yet as the laws of nature threaten to separate them, their unlikely bond transcends species and sorrow.

title: Stranger in Paradise
overview: In his last few breaths, a man drifts between vivid memories of the world he's leaving behind and haunting visions of what it might yet become

title: Man
overview: From within the walls of a prison, a group of inmates writes scenes about a ”Man”. As they act out their stories, their cells transform into childhood bedrooms, hospital rooms, and places flooded by the outside world's light. But as the story unfolds, the lines between imagination and reality blur, and we begin to wonder who this Man could be.

title: Kneaded
overview: It's been 16 years since Rosemary returned home to her tiny tight-knit Newfoundland community following the untimely death of her husband. Through death, loss, and years of self-sacrifice she gives until it is time to give up the ghost.

title: Don't Drink That!
overview: A group of international students at an American university can't agree on where to get a cup of coffee.

title: '05 Forever
overview: Was this one of the best teams ever? Paul Konerko, Mark Buehrle, AJ Pierzynski and more talk about the challenges of winning a World Series and the legacy of the 2005 Chicago White Sox.  A Paul Konerko grand slam, unlikely home runs from Scott Podsednik and Geoff Blum, Juan Uribe diving into the stands and Bobby Jenks closing out the four-game sweep – these are the moments fans remember forever. Hear the first-hand account and watch behind-the-scenes footage of the team that accomplished it all.

title: Redemption
overview: A handsome young man, tired of his day job, alleviates his boredom by going on dates with women every night. However, his plans backfire when one of his dates is unexpectedly murdered one night. Police remain hot on his trail as this murder mystery slowly unfolds.

title: Contagion
overview: Yoon-kyu is suffering from a terrible toothache but can't afford timely treatment due to a lack of money. One day, while staring into the mirror in pain in a bathroom, he hears the voice of a stranger. The man asks Yoon-kyu to buy him items like toilet paper and underwear. When Yoon-kyu, flustered, refuses, the man offers him money. Desperate for cash, Yoon-kyu reluctantly accepts the offer… and begins to grow closer to someone he should never have come face to face with.

title: The Exposure
overview: The film, based on Schnitzler's 1924 novella "Fräulein Else," follows Lili, a 19-year-old lawyer's daughter, who undergoes a humiliating naked show to prevent her father's imprisonment.

title: The Boy and the Dragon
overview: When the ritual for Ingong's graduation film goes completely wrong, he sets out to find a pig's head. The moment he steps outside, a strange new world unfolds. There, he is hailed as the legendary hero destined to defeat an evil dragon. There is only one way back to reality: slay the dragon!

title: Dreamworks: Shooting For The Moon
original_title: Dreamworks: La Tete Dans La Lune
overview: The documentary highlights the history of Dreamworks Animation from artists’ perspective.

title: Listen Then Repeat
overview: Locked out of her primary email and all of its associated accounts, Eve attempts to troubleshoot the issue with an AI-powered customer service hotline whose only goal is to improve her satisfaction no matter the cost.

title: The Silent Canvas
overview: An anthology movie that tells the story of a painting in an art exhibition that has the mysterious ability to inspire an emotional reaction out of anyone who views it, but the chaos this courses starts to have an effect on the gallery’s straight-laced curator who demands only perfection.

title: On Dissonance
overview: In the aftermath of a distancing relationship, a young couple are left to navigate distorted memories and emotional fragmentation in a haunting reflection on transformation and miscommunication.

title: No Surprises
overview: A war veteran is going through his normal nightly routine, but as police sirens rush past his house, PTSD strikes. He begins reliving his past.

title: The Felling
overview: The Felling film is a David-and-Goliath story about how a small group of residents in one of Europe’s greenest cities battled to stop a powerful city council and a giant multinational corporation from chopping down thousands of healthy street trees as part of a massive £2.2 billion private contract to maintain the city's highways.

title: The River Runs Through the Village
original_title: Το Ποτάμι Περνάει από το Χωριό
overview: Memory is our only true wealth. Andreas learns this the hard way, as his father who is suffering from Alzheimer's cannot recognize him anymore. In his attempt to help his father remember, Andreas loses track of the time following the path carved by footprints of memory.  The story of a man nearing 40, who watches old videotapes of the family's memories, in the old house in the village. However, this trip leads Andrea to neglect his appointment with Danae at their future apartment.

title: A Poorly Told Story
overview: Pedro, an ordinary man who feels useless, is confronted by his own narrator, a voice unafraid to expose his greatest insecurities.

title: Weaving
overview: Soohyun, a solitary professional boxer, is preparing for a match when she spars with Minkyung, an amateur who boxes as a hobby, and takes a solid hook from her. After the hit, Soohyun begins to feel drawn to Minkyung, who suddenly enters her life, causing her match preparation to falter.

title: Olympiacos: The Legend
overview: Olympiacos: The Legend is the epic story of a season that defied all expectations and rewrote European football history. In 2023/24, Olympiacos shattered barriers by becoming the first Greek club to win a European trophy-and didn't stop there. In a feat never before accomplished, they claimed not one but two major continental titles: the UEFA Europa Conference League and the UEFA Youth League.

title: My Friend Miles
overview: Miles, a particularly playful spirit, lures his friend Solta on a journey from Berlin to Friuli, Picardy and Venice, through his life, through the minefields of identity politics, and through the black hole of our oblivion as to what the world could be. Ultimately, he returns to Ireland, the land of his childhood, where he played marbles during the raw identity war of the troubles. Solta tries to track him down, to figure him out, to picture him. Miles, however, marbles in his pockets, infinity in his fingers, constantly eludes him.

title: Abode
overview: In ABODE, five interwoven stories explore the meaning of home, across city streets and country kitchens, strained families and surreal technologies, revealing how identity, memory, and connection shape the places we call our own.

title: Estrella, cometa, satélite y planeta
overview: A documentary celebrating the life of Fernando Estrella, a pioneering LGBTI activist and beloved cultural icon. Through testimonies from friends and collaborators, it traces his fearless advocacy, artistic brilliance, and deep impact on queer visibility in Spain—from the Movida Madrileña to his influential presence in Palma. A chef, performer, and actor in Almodóvar’s films, Estrella defied norms and built community, especially through his legendary restaurant, Flexa. The film culminates in the surreal and moving farewell party held just before his death in 2023, a testament to the love he inspired.

title: The Wayfinder
overview: Brothers Blake and Brady are sent to Earth to see if it’s inhabitable after the war has now finally ended. But out of nowhere, their ship crashes. When Blake wakes up, he is on his own and lost. He must find his brother Brady before the horrors of what remains of Earth catches him first.

title: African Kung Fu Nazis II
overview: After the successful release of African Kung Fu Nazis part I; are you ready for the crazy whacked-out continuation in part II. This time hated villain Adolf Robotler reappears and wants to become President & Reichskanzler of Ghana with the help of his henchmen. But something seems off with Adolf; some think he is a robot, also In his way are local Kung Fu hero Addo (younger brother of Addae from part 1) and his sidekick Sek Tin. Together they embark on a quest to learn new Kung Fu styles, take out Hitler’s henchmen and finally face the master of evil himself. But the two heroes will encounter a “monstrous surprise”…

title: A Vampire in the Cinematheque
overview: After being attacked, Rogério starts to feel strange. As he sinks into the routine of a new internship at the Cinemateca do Desterro, he feels that he will never be the same again.

title: Between Two Waves
overview: After her mother’s death, Cass Milligan returns home for the first time in years, only to find the house isn’t done with her. She’s convinced it’s haunted. Her twin brother thinks she’s unraveling. As buried memories surface, they must uncover the truth before the past swallows her whole.

title: BKFC 78: Leonardo Perdomo vs Arnold Adams
original_title: BKFC 78: Leonardo Perdomo vs Arnold Adams
overview: Leonardo Perdomo and Arnold Adams go head-to-head in a thrilling heavyweight showdown.

title: Avril Lavigne en concert au Main Square Festival 2024
original_title: Avril Lavigne en concert au Main Square Festival 2024

title: Drew Lynch: The Stuttering Comedian
overview: Drew creates new hour long special on youtube with material that is to answer any questions might you have about his stutter, his injury, its impact on his life and the recovery he went through. He also talks about his wife (who actually makes an appearance in this one), speech therapy, softball, depression, and a journey to McDonald's.

title: Murder Down Under: Murder by Mushroom
original_title: Murder Down Under: Murder by Mushroom
overview: Australia's most unusual triple-murder conviction – Why did Erin Patterson kill her lunch guests by serving them beef wellington laced with poisonous death cap mushrooms ?

title: The Dreamer
overview: Although he spent most of his life fighting ethnic discrimination, Yosef Shiloach is best remembered by the public for his comedic roles in Bourekas films. Yet behind the clownish image that clung to him was a deep, complex, and courageous artist who sought to change Israeli reality. He met with Yasser Arafat in his office and fought for peace—actions that ultimately forced him to leave the country. Shiloach was also a prolific writer—of songs, poems, screenplays, and more. Through his writings and rare, personal footage filmed by his daughter, we gain insight into the inner world of a man who began supporting his family at age nine and became one of Israel’s greatest actors.

title: The Writer’s Horror
overview: An egotistical horror writer turns to ChatGPT for help in writing a new script. As artificial intelligence blurs the lines between fiction and reality, eerie and disturbing events unfold in an isolated cabin in the forests of Thailand.

title: Closed
overview: Closed follows restaurant manager Hana, who becomes trapped inside the kitchen’s freezer room overnight, immediately after a spat with one of her co-workers. As she tries to survive the freezing conditions, she begins to question whether she’s the only one locked inside.

title: Elegance
overview: Two gangsters got a bad reputation, despite their successes. However, there's a mission that will not succeed as expected.

title: Assembly Line Fashionista
original_title: 杀马特教父杀出工厂流水线后，该杀去何处
overview: Luo Fuxing is the ‘godfather’ of Shamate, an alternative Chinese subcultural movement. Two decades into his career he takes on a new challenge: theatre.

title: Buddies and the Heir
overview: When the owner of a hotel in Uruguay dies, Stallone (a man with Down syndrome) decides that he is the rightful heir, ignoring Thin (an autistic), the deceased's adopted son. Stallone gathers friends from his former boarding school and together they set off on a perilous journey on a cargo plane. Suddenly, their paths cross with smugglers hunting for jewels.

title: The Two of Us
overview: Devastated by the murder of his daughter Elle on Christmas Eve, Tim Edwards finds solace and embarks on a transformative quest for healing and self-discovery.

title: Hudson’s Bay(bies)
overview: A documentary film exploring an untold part of Canada’s past through the eyes of Inuk artist and filmmaker Elisapie Isaac. After facing a moral dilemma, Elisapie sets out to meet others who, like her, are “Hudson Baybies,” the children born of the mixed unions between Indigenous women and Hudson’s Bay Company employees working in trading posts and general stores across the North.

title: The Traveler
overview: New York, 1887 - In an isolated farmhouse, a reclusive widow is haunted by a supernatural presence she longs to be her late husband. As the spirit grows increasingly hostile, she questions whether something far more sinister is lurking.

title: And She Didn't Die
overview: A daughter uncovers her mother's radical journey from rural South Africa to exile, and how storytelling can become a weapon of resistance and a tool of healing.

title: Ricky
overview: Rick is a teenager who doesn't feel happy in his body and decides to lose weight by running.

title: Murder on the Newfie Bullet
overview: As Newfoundland and Labrador hurtles toward its Confederation vote, a murder aboard the infamous train turns a routine journey into a chaotic political whodunit where every passenger has a motive, and the future of a nation might just be riding on a narrow gauge.

title: ¿Por qué nadie me lo dijo?
overview: ¿Por qué nadie me lo dijo? immerses the viewer in the internal struggle of Jordi, a Spanish film director, who tries to overcome the aftermath of a toxic relationship. Media harassment, doubts about his talent and the fear of returning to to love are intertwined in a plot that explores the limits of manipulation and psychological violence. A film that lays bare the shadows of being a man and the importance of mental health.

title: Hollow Inventory of a Grey Matter
original_title: Hollow Inventory of a Grey Matter
overview: Shot during the summer of 2024, Hollow Inventory of a Grey Matter centers on the pointless but somehow pleasing wonder for meaningless wondering. The sight, the touch, a music in the air and a smell perhaps, 28 seconds of a stranger's view.

title: The Manipulation of Natalia Grace
overview: An emotionally unfit couple seek to adopt and care for a precocious child.

title: Death in the Desert: The Nurse Helen Mystery
original_title: Death in the Desert: The Nurse Helen Mystery
overview: In 1979, 23 year old British nurse Helen Smith died in suspicious circumstances in Saudi Arabia. The Saudi authorities quickly ruled it an accident, but their refusal to investigate further created international mystery, with accusations that the Thatcher government was more interested in oil than justice. Now, 45 years on, previously classified documents reveal in this documentary what the British government really knew about Helen's death.

title: Chrysanthemum
overview: When her daughter mysteriously vanishes in a garden centre, an anguished gardener develops an unhealthy relationship with a chrysanthemum plant.

title: Love or Lie
original_title: ฮักสัปปะลี่กับคดีสีชมพู
overview: When Yo, a down-on-his-luck detective, receives a bizarre assignment from a mysterious client, he finds himself tasked with investigating Frank, a shady businessman, and Poche, a sweet-voiced singer. His mission? To play matchmaker and make them fall in love. But things take an unexpected turn when he meets Pun, a nosy market vendor trained by the legendary Mae Jaem and Poche’s older sister, who senses something fishy about this strange case of the pineapple cupid!

title: Atado
overview: Somewhere, a man tinkers, cooks, and smokes in silence, caught between the tranquility of an afternoon nap and the strangeness of time stretching out.

title: Véronique Sanson aux Francofolies de la Rochelle
original_title: Véronique Sanson aux Francofolies de la Rochelle

title: VIH: La causa justa
overview: In this inspiring film, the stories of six people who live with HIV—either directly or indirectly—are portrayed. Through a journey into their lives, we discover what it means to live with this condition and begin to break down the barriers and misconceptions that have been built over more than four decades, contributing to a stigma that no longer reflects the reality of HIV today. A mother with HIV who was able to have a healthy child, a patient who has lived with the disease for over twenty years, a father who lost his son in this battle, a man who was diagnosed but has maintained a safe sexual relationship with his partner for years, and a young man born with HIV who fights every day to raise awareness about the issue.

title: The Hand
overview: Khmer horror film.

title: Taper
overview: A queer Black kid who attends a predominantly White college needs a haircut. He finds a suitable Black barbershop but then feels the need to tone it down to blend in.

title: Slow Disco
overview: A study on the importance, beauty, and difficulty of reflection and its role in becoming who you are.

title: Pisces
overview: A group of students form a ritual around a woman who undergoes numerous spirtual sexual experiences until encountering the Devine Messenger.

title: No, Thanks, I Quit Smoking
overview: After being fired NURIA (22), a philosophy major dropout has 24 hours to get the rest of her rent money or move back with her mom. All of this while she tries to make it through a whole day without smoking.

title: PARA VIVIR: The Implacable Times of Pablo Milanés
original_title: Para vivir. El implacable tiempo de Pablo Milanés
overview: Many recognize and admire the work and voice of Pablo Milanés. Few know the story of how he became an emblematic figure of Cuba and Latin America.This is a portrait of the artist, the battles he had to fight and the complex time he went through and how he enriched it with his singing.

title: Épaves, des oasis pour la nature
original_title: Épaves, des oasis pour la nature
overview: From simple wooden debris to imposing ship structures, shipwrecks are an unprecedented source of marine biodiversity. As breeding refuges, protection zones and sources of food, their functions are manifold. These unique habitats enable a variety of species, from seahorses to white sharks, to thrive in the ocean depths

title: White Guilt
overview: Eleven affluent white individuals in their twenties and thirties embark on a journey aboard a bus, seeking to assuage their white guilt through a pay-to-play service.

title: Please, ̶D̶o̶n̶'̶t̶ Stay
overview: The lonely routine of Camila changes when a boy shows up at her doorstep, and tries to create a connection with her.

title: Shards of Light
overview: War has ravaged the Ukrainian city of Bucha, whose residents have endured unimaginable hostility and suffering. If hope remains a faint glimmer, the will to survive still shines through in this powerful and unflinching film.

title: The Sound of Water Footsteps
overview: A documentary with images and views of Taq-e Bostan in Kermanshah and poems by Sohrab Sepehri.

title: The Traveler & The Troll
overview: A short film following a lost and weary traveler as they come face-to-face with the monstrous warden of the cursed woods and a deadly bargain with which they must contend.

title: Angkor, le mystère des temples de bronze
original_title: Angkor, le mystère des temples de bronze

title: Las Patricias
overview: A group of mother get together to create a plan to kill the teacher, chaos ensues.

title: Solo Female
overview: The new and inexperienced OnlyFans creator Mathilde attends an "OnlyFans Gathering" – a weekend where creators meet to work, that is, to produce pornographic content together for their profiles. Mathilde goes there hoping for success – but in reality, she is probably searching more for a sense of belonging. She hasn’t anticipated how challenging the weekend will become, or what kind of demands and expectations the world of OnlyFans actually places on her. Mathilde quickly realizes that the weekend will culminate in a live-streamed group sex scene, to be carried out with a hired photographer and a male porn actor. While the others are looking forward to it, Mathilde hesitates – unsure if it’s something she truly wants to be a part of.

title: IT´S CHICO TIME!
overview: In 1974, Chico, a beloved host of a children’s TV show at the service of a repressive authoritarian regime, is forced to make the hardest decision of his life: murder a colleague live on air, or lose the approval of his powerful father. As the cameras roll, the program unravels into a surreal theatre of obedience, repression, and madness.

title: Act Black
overview: A first year black actor who is deeply inspired by black cinema is traveling through a journey of understanding what it takes to become a successful actor in moment of time where gigs, jobs and opportunities are not provided for him during the hot, humid summer set in a urban city Newark.

title: Uma Rua Chamada Triumpho 1969/70
overview: A short film made  from photos of Boca do Lixo, a bohemian and marginal neighborhood, and its people.

title: Li Yong
overview: This documentary presents the local church history and an individual life history from a personal perspective.

title: Alone
overview: A French photographer of Armenian descent embarks on a personal journey to trace the footsteps of her ancestor, a survivor placed in an Armenian orphanage during the 1915 Genocide. As she delves into the past, her path unexpectedly crosses with Artur, a lonely boy forced to abandon his dreams in a country where the looming shadow of war shapes every life. Their encounter weaves together memory and present, exile and belonging, revealing the enduring scars of history and the fragile hopes of a new generation.

title: Rétilin
overview: Sylvain, a 72-year-old man, learns that he is going to lose his sight just as his daughter is about to give birth to her first child.

title: The Ghost of the Cat
overview: A man who once ran over a black cat now accompanies the owner of another to bury it, hoping for redemption, release from bad luck, or something he himself cannot quite name.

title: Wake Me Up, My First Love
original_title: Wake Me Up, My First Love
overview: Cathy, the fierce boss of the Scorpion Gang, falls into a coma after a staged car accident. When she wakes up, her family elders deceive her into bringing home Prince Alexander of Monaco as a sperm donor to secure an heir. Though they start off disliking each other, sparks slowly begin to fly. Neither of them realizes that Alexander is actually Cathy's long-lost childhood sweetheart—and they’ve been searching for each other all along.

title: Life at 50C: The Battle of Doongmabulla Springs
original_title: Life at 50C: The Battle of Doongmabulla Springs
overview: In Australia’s coal country, the inside story of one Aboriginal family fighting to stop a mine on their traditional land. Adani, which owns the mine, says it’s operating lawfully.

title: Distance Between Two Points of Me
overview:
A poetic reflection on memory, loss, and the search for home. The film explores the invisible line between who we were and who we are becoming — a distance that often begins with a small, ordinary object that suddenly brings the past into sharp focus. At its heart, this is a true story — a quiet tribute to a sister, and to the space that grew between two people once so close. It is about a relationship changed forever, and a home someone chose to stay in, no matter the cost.
 Through a dialogue with something as simple as a piece of fruit, the character reconnects with a moment of care, warmth, and protection — a sense of home now lost.
 For many modern Ukrainians, this is not just a metaphor. Homes have been physically destroyed, and what remains is memory.

title: The Sea
overview: Khaled (12), a Palestinian boy is on his way to visit the sea for the first time in his life, at the checkpoint, the Israeli authorities deny his entry. Determined, Khaled sneaks into Israel and embarks on a dangerous journey to the sea. Meanwhile, Ribhi, his father, is trying to trace his whereabouts, putting himself at risk of being arrested and losing his job.

title: Neil Young - Live at Glastonbury Festival
original_title: Neil Young - Live at Glastonbury Festival

title: Forbidden Valentine
overview: An animated short about AI and true love.

title: Blink
overview: A son finds himself suspended in time, haunted by a presence that seems both familiar and distant. As he navigates a looped reality from a single point of view, fragments of memory and emotion begin to surface, hinting at something deeper left unresolved.

title: HIGH STAKES
overview: HIGH STAKES is a gripping crime thriller set in the turbulent streets of 1970s Los Angeles. The story follows two laid-back detectives, Adam Ralpot and Sal Astrana, who find themselves thrust into the city's dark underbelly when they are assigned to investigate a gruesome murder tied to the escalating drug trade. As they delve deeper into the case, they cross paths with a ruthless crime lord, Mateo 'El Escorpión' Navarro, leading to a high-stakes confrontation that tests their wits and courage. With a blend of humor, action, and suspense, "High Stakes" captures the gritty essence of the era while keeping viewers on the edge of their seats.

title: Erich's New Shirt
overview: After an unfortunate internet purchase, Erich finds himself with a problem: he now has a terrible shirt that threatens to ruin his life. Thankfully, his friend Robin has a way to get a replacement, but it comes at the cost of having to visit the enigmatic Shirt Dealer. Will Erich be able to get a new shirt, or will he be doomed to a life of shame?

title: how strange it is to be anything at all
original_title: how strange it is to be anything at all

title: Are You Open?
overview: A bookshop owner's prosaic life changes when he is reunited with a friend with whom he shared the love for films.

title: December
overview: Amid December’s festive glow, refugees remain hidden in forests along the Poland-Belarus border. This powerful documentary gives voice to their silent cries.

title: Miraba caer las gotas iluminadas por los relámpagos, y cada que respiraba suspiraba, y cada vez que pensaba, pensaba en ti
original_title: Miraba caer las gotas iluminadas por los relámpagos, y cada que respiraba suspiraba, y cada vez que pensaba, pensaba en ti
overview: Through the tides of the Pacific Ocean, the origins and legacy of colonialism unfold in interwoven stories. Following the historic route of the Manila Galleon — which connected the Philippines and New Spain, ferrying Chinese goods from 1565 to 1815 — time bends and blurs. Past and present collide in a surreal tapestry of automated beings, shifting spaces, and fleeting lights fading into shadow.

title: The Roaming Center for Magnetic Alternatives
original_title: The Roaming Center for Magnetic Alternatives
overview: The Roaming Center for Magnetic Alternatives follows a mobile archiving center in a cargo trailer as it crosses the Midwest to digitize the VHS tapes of LGBTQ+ folks living in Middle America. In real-time digitizing sessions, people watch their own histories as they are being preserved, and reveal a look into queer life in the Bible Belt since the 1980s. This film takes a road trip through the past into the present, and gives us a glimpse of what an ever-expanding queer archive looks like in the future.

title: ORION
overview: “ORION” is a gritty action short film about the cost of justice, the pain of loss, and the lengths one person will go to get revenge.

title: Thanks, Babs!
overview: Meet Babs, an optimistic octogenarian speed-racing through life, one five-year plan at a time.  Like a modern day Maude from Harold and Maude, Babs moves through life at breakneck speed. She spars with her ex over her 5-year plan for relationships, admitting to a reputation for always having her vibrator. She lap-dances at a party celebrating the 41st anniversary of her 39th birthday, threatening to kick anyone who says “80” out the door. A trip to the AIDS memorial grove on the heels of aquacise class at the Jewish Community Center sparks a glorious rumination on a possible afterlife.

title: Алиса
overview: Nobody knows what's waiting for us around the corner. On the last day of her 13th birthday, following a rabbit into a St. Petersburg gateway by a strange attraction, Alice suddenly finds herself in a mysterious forest. A place where everything is the other way around. To the wild sounds of a piano, which is driven along country roads on a tractor, Alice meets a wild company that, instead of St. Valentine's Day, celebrates the feast of St. Tryphon the Mouser, unable to leave the festive table from winter to summer because of the curse of the Elder, who punished them for "blasphemy." Helping to solve this problem, Alice receives a motorcycle as a gift - both a dream and a means of transportation - and sets off on a journey. Where will it lead her? What awaits her, a lonely and strong girl? And most importantly, why did she tag along with the white rabbit? Who are her parents? And who is she really...

title: Terroir
overview: A young wine critic (Madison Hu) returns to a French vineyard one year after giving it a bad review. There, she and her friends become the target of a masked killer.

title: touching electricity
overview: upon ordering a guitar to the wrong address, three boys take it back home where it belongs.

title: Soflty spoken from the other room
original_title: Soflty spoken from the other room
overview: Based on childhood recollections, the narrative unfolds within a fabricated house, unknown passages and rooms within. Acting as a search, following the distortions and errors that appear as memories fade, ultimately questioning the unreliable nature of memory itself.

title: The Language of the Unfaithful
overview: On an ordinary night in Madrid, Manuel — a young, upper-class conservative — unexpectedly runs into his ex-girlfriend Lucía outside a nightclub. What begins as a fleeting encounter unravels into a cascade of memories.  The Language of the Unfaithful is an intimate, character-driven drama that explores the tension between societal expectations and the contradictions that lie beneath the surface of personal identity. Told through subtle, everyday moments, the film offers a raw and emotionally resonant look at love, loss, and self-discovery.

title: Gilles Vigneault: au coeur du pays
original_title: Gilles Vigneault: au coeur du pays

title: Spectrum Syndicate
overview: In the fictional country of Magorigan, where autistic people have just been segregated from society and the workplace, a creative autistic individual named Sora Altair must join a group of special secret agents to save the world from a bomb.

title: The Abduction of Pierce
overview: While trying to go to sleep, Pierce sees an ominous figure in the parking spaces below his house.

title: In Good Hands
overview: Minutes before the end of her shift, a Black ER Doctor is forced to take on two of the most challenging patient circumstances of her career in a tense Western, PA hospital.

title: Devolution / A.K.A. Rest In Peace
overview:
A short film edited in 2 halves.
 Devolution was edited by Austin Smith.
 A.K.A. Rest In Peace was edited by Milan Morris-Gibson.

title: Éric Rohmer, Childhood Spirit
overview: The documentary delves into Éric Rohmer's distinctive filmmaking process, using film clips, rare interviews, and unreleased test footage.

title: I Don’t Really Care if I’m Not Loved
The Negotiator
overview: In a world riven with conflict what is needed to turn war into peace? How can all parties to a war become all parties to a peace? Experience shows it’s the presence of a critical individual in whom all sides can have confidence to chair talks and create the space for an agreement to emerge. In Northern Ireland, one of the few examples of a long-lasting negotiated peace settlement, that critical person was former US Senate Majority Leader, Senator George J Mitchell.

title: Terra: Reignition
overview: In the distant future, the human race has lost their home planet and is now ruled by an alien empire from an alternate dimension. On the capital planet of Vyrkeln, a human searching for their family is pulled into a conflict decades in the making by an underground resistance, while the empire's deadliest agents hunt them across the planet.

title: Parasomnia
overview: After playing a guided meditation to induce lucid dreaming, the protagonist begin to experience strange phenomena inside his home. As the dream deepens, the boundaries of reality blur, leading him toward a terrifying encounter with an unknown entity.

title: Our Water Ways
overview: A feature-length documentary supported by Patagonia, Weingart Foundation, and Climate Science Alliance that highlights Tribal nations with homelands in California’s forest, urban, desert, and coastal lands and the critical ways they protect sacred water.

title: Inner Portrait
overview: Follows four individuals as they travel beyond their familiar worlds. These contrasting travels became the basis for Refik Anadol's digital artwork. The film explores profound emotional shifts and the creative process, blending art, science, and human stories into a compelling narrative.

title: Het Grote Offensief
overview: The two rival Allied commanders, General Eisenhower and Field Marshal Montgomery,  clash in a battle of egos and strategic choices, with devastating consequences for the people of Zeeland during the liberation of the Netherlands.

title: Daria’s Night Flowers
overview: The night flowers in Daria’s garden hide the secrets of a country that has turned love stories into routine crime scenes. A tale of patriarchal violence combined with botanical (mis)uses, told from the archives of Iranian cinema.

title: A Growing Pain
overview: In a city gripped by political ambition, WIDI-an idealistic mayoral candidate finds his moral compass crumbling under the weight of a brutal campaign. With his pragmatic aide GALIH by his side, their fight for justice turns into a game of manipulation, black campaigns, and masked corruption.  As a relentless journalist, RAJA, uncovers the rot beneath their promises, tensions explode, morality clashes with ambition, and loyalty with betrayal. In the end, no one walks away clean.  Sakit Tumbuh is a dark political drama about the price of power, the death of idealism, and the scars left behind when hope is lost to compromise.

title: Midsummer Lucia
overview: The generation gap threatens to spoil everything when two grown grandchildren visit their grandmother in her garden. They have a special family tradition, but the grandmother thinks it's difficult to recreate the magic from the past when her grandchildren are always pressuring her to smoke in secret because everything has to be so 'woke'.

title: Phantom Leap
overview: A young man checks out his apartment pool.

title: Srishti
overview: Lured to the forbidden forests of the Himalayas, a photojournalist unearths secrets that unravel his mind and challenge the very nature of reality.

title: Ave Sangria, A Banda que Não Acabou
original_title: Ave Sangria, A Banda que Não Acabou

title: Untitled Mockumentary Comedy
overview: Three student filmmakers set out to capture each other's inner life struggles in an avant-garde documentary, but as the lens turns inward and time begins to lose meaning, they drift into an existential spiral of insanity—where memory fractures, selves unravel, and nothing remains quite real.

title: (Re)Born, a Self-Portrait
overview: A body dies, and a new one lives.

title: A Guilty Man
overview: An idol dealer gets a call for help from a friend but his decision haunts him forever.

title: It Must Be Because I Decided to Leave
overview: A dreamlike, fantastical drift around a fractured identity, with dazzling visual inventions. Like a diary that visually conveys a state of being between two worlds.

title: (M)OTHER
overview: Today is A-Wei’s last day, but it’s her first day with Ching.

title: Persistence
overview: El, a young anthropomorphic hyena woman, navigates the shadowy, litter-strewn back alleys of a sprawling futuristic city, where anthropomorphic animals and sentient robots of endless variety call home. El is in search of something lost to her and she is determined to find it. In hopes of answers, she heads into the inner city for something that could help...

title: Land's End
overview: Hugo, Elise, and Yoon navigate familial tensions and harsh realities, ultimately finding their way into each other's lives in unexpected ways.

title: Cloudcatchers
overview: A broken heart. A wooden horse. One woman’s rememberance at the water’s edge summons wild steeds to prove that true devotion never washes away

title: Tara
overview: A Dalit trans woman navigates love and identity after falling for an upper-caste man, forcing her to confront the silence around her caste. Tara is the story of a 26-year-old Dalit trans woman who meets a singer named Aman at a queer party, sparking an immediate connection.

title: Libertà
overview: A woman with Alzheimer's has spent her whole life making choices with integrity, but her illness leads to conflict with her daughter. This film explores whether character can or cannot overcome the consequences of Alzheimer's.

title: La Dispute – NOWDTC documentary by Martin (CHAPTER II – Twenty Paces In The Tree Line)
original_title: La Dispute – NOWDTC documentary by Martin (CHAPTER II – Twenty Paces In The Tree Line)
overview: Director Martin offers unprecedented access to the band's creative process, documenting their journey from initial concepts to final recordings in Australia. Experience the tensions, breakthroughs, and quiet moments of inspiration that birthed "No One Was Driving the Car" across Australia, Manila, Bicester, and Grand Rapids.

title: #1-1 Guard Post
overview: Sergeant Kim Seonyeob, nearing the end of his military service, quietly volunteers for night duty at the 1-1 guard post to dodge a grooming inspection. He's paired with Private Park Jihoon, a fresh-faced recruit. Their uneventful shift takes a sharp turn when the keen-eyed officer Park Jang-hyun makes an unexpected visit. As Kim Seonyeob's expression grows increasingly rigid, the secrets he's been hiding slowly rise to the surface…

title: Her Guardian
overview: As her wedding day approaches, Cantika sets out to find her estranged biological father, only to uncover a shocking truth: her father, long kept hidden by her late mother, has transitioned into a woman named Dewi. As Cantika and Dewi navigate  the complexities of their past and present, they must confront deep-seated wounds  and attempt to rebuild a relationship fractured by time and secrets.

title: That Orchestra with the Broken Instruments
original_title: That Orchestra with the Broken Instruments
overview: A broken string, fractured echo chamber, rusting valves. 100 musicians meet for four days of rehearsals. They speak different languages. Their instruments are broken.

title: AlgoKratia
overview: A referendum on the government's transition to an Artificial Intelligence marks the end of democracy. Sandra was one of the activists in the campaign against AI. Now she watches the results unfold helplessly, fearing the last remnants of critical thought will be suppressed.

title: Menino Gepeto
overview: This is the story of Geppetto, an 11-year-old boy who likes to create his own toys. His father, Genaro, is the one who builds them using wood from fallen trees in the Enchanted Forest. But what Geppetto doesn't know is that the Fairy Godmother lives there, who has the power to give life to his wooden toys.  The forest is beautiful, but all this wonder is under threat! Our characters will get involved in a great adventure to stop the evil Mr. Machado from illegally cutting down a single tree!

title: Last Resort
overview: Carla is the maid of a rich family.  Cosimo is a child neglected by his parents.  Two souls wounded by indifference in an austere and deafening villa. A mother looking for a son, a son in need of a mother.

title: Guts
overview: A son honors his mothers wish by leads life of an honest cop down a righteous path, where his every moral choice integrity invites relentless adversaries. Can he endure them and uphold justice?

title: MORE STAY MORE MONEY
overview: Constantly online, never at home: A film about the crew of a cargo ship, their loneliness, and their attempt to escape it. For months at a time, far from home and family, they live in cramped quarters. An allegory for the homelessness of modern humanity, caught in the monotony between machine, sea, work, and sleep.

title: Inflatable Bear, Hourly
overview: A young immigrant actress, dressed as a costumed bear, faces a surreal odyssey in Berlin’s Soviet-era outskirts, where a chaotic birthday party blends humor, tragedy, and the echoes of a home she can’t forget.

title: Katie Boyle: Terapy
overview: Get ready for a fearless, fast-paced, and laugh-out-loud comedy special from Irish comedian Katie Boyle, filmed live in New York City! In TERAPY, Katie hilariously unpacks culture shocks, Catholic guilt, American dating, therapy sessions, and awkward family moments with her signature mix of wit, charm, and emotional honesty. From growing up in Ireland to navigating modern life in the U.S., nothing is off limits—from mast*rb*tion mishaps and mental health to language mix-ups and avocado injuries.

title: Tubong Barako
overview: Small-scale farmers, Jennifer and Jonathan battle the growing challenges of climate change to keep Kapeng Barako alive. With limited resources and little external support, they rely on their ingenuity and perseverance to sustain their farm and preserve a legacy deeply rooted in their culture.

title: Beyond the Trail
overview: In the aftermath of World War II, "Sibir Base" stands isolated in a region littered with abandoned biological weapons known as "Iron Army." Leichtes, individuals brought from a defeated nation to atone for war crimes, live at this base. As they carry out their daily routines, they find themselves consumed by memories of what they have lost.

title: Fragments on the flow
overview: Fragments from Brussels, about the flow of the city, A cinema, A body, A film, and a wind that blows through the town. The film is a Schizomentry experience that blends real stories and fiction. After all, where is the border?

title: Lullaby for a Lily
overview: As a boy journeys to get back home, he finds everyone looking distorted.

title: Nikté-Ha, Journey To The Mayan Waterworld
original_title: Nikté-Ha, viaje al mundo del agua maya
overview: Along with Nikté-Ha, a young Mayan girl, we will dive into the heart of the Mayan culture and encounter an extraordinary biodiversity from the Caribbean Sea to the tropical rainforest, home of the majestic jaguar.

title: Pretty Little Baby
overview: After experiencing a tragic loss, a woman turns to her imagination to turn back the clock.

title: Setback
overview: After two friends finish a contract killing deal, things get out of hand and both have to suffer a setback...

title: Starguy
overview: When a star, bored of its endless existence, hears music coming from a distant speck, it shoots down to find itself on planet Earth. On their quest to find music, they are helped by an ex-dance champion and a jaded musician, and faced with the impermanence of living a mortal life.

title: Acts of Slime and Stone
overview: Alone and desperate in a dark cave, O creates his ex-girlfriend in a blob of slime and must confront old patterns in their relationship and his own self-image.

title: Necrophilia
overview: Medical examiner Gi-yeon receives the unidentified body of a woman from detective Seok-hyeon. Over time, Gi-yeon finds himself falling in love with the corpse. When he hears that the body is to be cremated, he attempts to flee with it, evading Seok-hyeon. But in the end, the body is incinerated at the crematorium, and Gi-yeon is driven to make an unexpected decision.

title: Hollywood Pandemonium
overview: Hollywood Pandemonium is a fever-drenched descent into the occult underbelly of Tinseltown, where fallen starlets and demonic muses wage war beneath flickering marquees. Neon bleeds, contracts are signed in flesh, and the silver screen becomes an altar of possession and decay. In this surreal apocalypse of fame, desire is ritual, and every spotlight burns like a curse.

title: É Tudo Ensaio
overview: In three acts, the film shows the search for a definition of film-essay, exploring its limits.

title: It's Showtime
overview: Aging Jackass star, Dave England, is heading into a downward spiral of desperation that unlocks something dark in him. Haunted by the curse of celebrity, he commits unspeakable acts to once again garner the world's attention.

title: Mahuru
overview: Mahuru, a young Indigenous woman, is chosen to represent peace on her island. Amid ancestral rituals and weighty decisions, she must forge her own path in search of freedom and the right to love. Mahuru is a journey of courage, love, and the strength it takes to stay true to one’s feelings.

title: Pyan
overview: There was once a prosperous kingdom under the sea, where mermaids lived happily, until the fairies raised them to the surface. That was when the mermaid Hlaine was captured, kept in a tank within a museum, forced to perform tricks for the fairies' entertainment.  As centuries passed, the mermaids raised to the surface grew legs and learnt to live among fairies. Mae, a young girl on an overnight school trip to the museum meets Hlaine and becomes enamoured with mermaid culture. Might this be Hlaine's chance to return home?

title: Глубокий сосуд
overview: An ironic drama unfolds in a cramped recording studio: a failed actor with a velvety voice and an empty wallet voices a book about easy money and successful success, "Deep Vessel", until he explodes from the absurdity and stupidity of what he is reading. His hysteria develops into a conflict with the sound engineer, where both realize the bitterness of their unfulfilled hopes. For a moment they wonder: maybe they are the losers, and the book's nonsense is the truth?

title: Jochen Otten: Opgekropt Staat Netjes
overview: Recording of the eighth theatre programme by Dutch comedian Jochen Otten. Otten is tired of bottling everything up. So in this show, he no longer backs down from anything.

title: Abducted Files
overview: In this mockumentary, a crew of ufologists revisits lost UFO footage from 2016 in Brazil. When shocking evidence resurfaces in 2024, they uncover a government conspiracy. Amid awkward encounters and cosmic chaos, they must decide whether to expose the truth or vanish into silence.

title: Briganti. Rugby vs mafia
overview: A human story with sport as its central theme. Through rugby and its values, a man, Piero Mancuso, confronts the Cosa Nostra so that the young people of the Sicilian neighbourhood of Librino do not fall into its nets.

title: The Dream Job
overview: After a violent blow to the head, a lonely office worker wishing to be noticed suddenly finds himself the center of attention, which makes him question his reality as he slowly unravels

title: Playing With Fire in Water
overview: Young-hoon, the lighting director of a musical, has an out-of-body experience during the intermission of his final performance before retirement. As a wandering spirit, he encounters Soyul, an actress in the show.

title: The Rewind
overview: Josh is desperate to get back his wife, Nina. He turns to a new technology that allows users to re-live a difficult moment in hope of learning important lessons. Impatient for results he soon discovers that Rewind therapy is not the magic fix he hoped for and there are those who would put this tech to a more sinister use?

title: The Holy Gram
overview: Two lives, two lines, two friends… Olga and Fabiana are exactly that. Two close companions navigating a world where they seek approval from men to feel accepted—only to be weighed down by guilt afterward. Can they save the world while completely out of it? They certainly believe so. A tribute to those rare, sharp moments of clarity that strike when everything else is a blur.

title: The Last Spy
overview: The riveting biography of 102-year-old CIA spymaster Peter Sichel, who unpacks the obscured roots of conflicts that plague today’s world and the toll espionage took on his personal life.

title: Star Fall In Me
overview: Hana (23) is a young woman trying to adapt to her new surroundings by joining a band with her cousin, Arum (22). She writes a song for their band, hoping they can make it into a music audition. But her strong desire to always be in the spotlight starts causing tension within the group. Eventually, things fall apart, and she loses her sense of direction haunted by memories of her late mother. It's through this breakdown that she finally begins to realise the mistakes she’s made.

title: Soft Armor
overview: Soft Armor is an adult coming-of-age film about being passive to the world you live in, but then meeting someone who does the opposite and through them finding the courage to live your own life and challenge the world.

title: Skeleton Girls. A Kidnapped Society
overview: A young woman on the run must survive a news cycle frenzy in order to escape a dangerous plot involving a notorious girl gang.

title: Devils on Horses
overview: Set against the brutal backdrop of the Sinai-Palestine campaigns in WWI, this powerful story reveals the unbreakable bond between soldiers and their horses, trusted companions that offered comfort, courage, and connection in the face of unrelenting war. Through stunning visuals, raw interviews, and immersive reenactments, the film brings to life the emotional journey of men who found strength in their steeds.

title: Szypliszki
overview: Sam, a middle-aged man en route to a Polish village to romance the likely-imaginary woman of his dreams, spends an overnight layover in Queens with his niece and her girlfriend whose relationship is on its last legs.

title: OKTAGON 72: Vémola vs. Végh 3
overview: Return to Eden with the best card in OKTAGON history It's 1:1. Végh dominated the match of the century in 2019. The rematch of the century at the Eden football stadium in 2024, won by Vémola, became the biggest tournament in the Czech Republic and Slovakia across all sports and broke viewing records. On June 14, we return to Eden with the best card in history, where the final decision will be made. Judgment Day and the last match of both icons' careers! Who will go down in history and become the greatest legend of the Czech-Slovak fighting scene?

title: Сырная история
overview: A young man is obsessed with the idea of creating his own cheese, but he fails. By chance, the guy finds out that there is a farm where you can make cheese professionally. However, mice living on the farm stand in his way.

title: No Sympathy for the Devil
overview: A modern version of Orpheus and Eurydice. A romance in extremes set at a dystopian future by the acclaimed Greek director Dimitri Athanitis. Provocative, already a cult film. After being released from prison, Eurydice gets a job as a waitress but also as a naked model for a mysterious photographer who blackmails her. Orpheus, a cashier at a super market meets her by chance and falls for her at once. When he loses her, he shall travel all the way to hell, to get her back. Dimitri Athanitis's take on the "Orpheus and Eurydice" myth is stylish and sexy. Lena Kitsipoulou is totally magnetic for her fellow characters and the viewer.

title: Entre Nous (Between Us)
overview: Two friends must decide whether their differing visions of their futures are compatible  with their friendship.

title: Goodbye Party
overview: Newly broken up with and over everything, Rowan throws himself a goodbye party before he blasts himself out of Brooklyn - literally.

title: Interview With A Hero
overview: An enigmatic Cambodian-Australian puppeteer’s life begins to unravel during a TV performance. Can he be vulnerable to his young daughter about the genocide he fled?

title: Invocation of My Demon Sister
overview: A ritual shot on black and white Super 8 film. A witch summons various goddesses and mythological figures until the Queen of women shunned by patriarchy—Lilith—breaks through.

title: Fall To Pieces
overview: Young kid dragged into a life of crime by viciously corrupt politician and business man "Sebastian October". Tangled in a web of lies the protagonist "Dominic" does everything he can to live a normal life but keeps getting pulled back into the life he so desperately wants to leave.

title: RIP MAEVE
overview: RIP MAEVE follows an Irish dancing company in the midst of its church-hall tour. This tour descends into bloodthirsty chaos when a vampire joins the troupe.  Obsessed by Ronan and Caoimhe, the company’s principal dancers and star couple, Maeve seems to have found her latest victims. Is Maeve simply envious of their stardom in the dancing world, or is she after more than just centre stage?

title: Quando A Noite É Vermelha
overview: May 2, 2024. Amidst big names from São Paulo's drag scene, a young filmmaker dives into the experience of becoming a drag queen for one night.

title: Something about Mamma
overview: An home movie documentary about a young man with a camera who tries to recount and reframe a pivotal moment in his childhood: the death of his mother. An intimate and personal story about what remains of that mother-son relationship, now marked by an unbridgeable distance and an absence with which it is necessary to come to terms.

title: Portuguese Joe
overview: An old gunman travels the Alentejo in search of revenge, accompanied by the mute daughter of one of his targets.

title: Linhas Tortas
overview: During the annual get-together dinner of four friends, three thieves decide to rob the place, but their past brings the unusual stage of this robbery to the present.

title: Shipment
overview: Shipment is a dark crime drama about Frankie Romeo, a young man thrust into a high-stakes, high-pressure, underground operation involving a series of mysterious packages, family betrayals, and deadly secrets. With increasing anxiety, and the clock running out, Frankie must navigate dangerous threats, fractured family dynamics, and secret truths.

title: Together
overview: Bound by a promise made long ago, five friends must call each other by name and sing the song of the stars as one. Only then can they save themselves and the world.

title: Z! The Magical Girl
overview: Zatanna Zatara’s origin is explained in this feature length continuation of Max Landis’ Kryptonian Epic. It is the longest piece of visual media dedicated to the character in the history of DC.

title: Sofia Metro Inside Out
overview: Deep beneath Sofia lies a heavily surveilled network of tunnels, bunkers, and Soviet-era subway stations, Largely unseen, rarely photographed, and almost impossible to access. Sofia Metro Inside Out is the result of almost a decade spent navigating and documenting this elusive metro system from within. Led by the anonymous photographer known only as Errorflict, and his steadfast accomplice Seco, this striking project blends high-resolution photography with wild tales of struggle, fear, loss, and victory. Not only against the authorities, but also against the artists' internal fears.

title: Every Note You Play
overview: A radical experiment: 16 world-class musicians come together in Monheim, North Rhine-Westphalia - without guidelines, without a plan, just with an audience.

title: Little Wooden Bears
overview: As a woodcarver comes close to death while gathering materials in the wilderness, he meets a familiar face who may have some insight on what to expect.

title: The Disposers
overview: An upcoming movie by Chris Escorrega and Thomas Petahtegoose

title: Una tarde en el cine
overview: Every day, from 5pm to 10pm, a particular cinema opens its doors in the city center.

title: Between These Times
overview: A 10-hour, 'slow TV' film, documenting 10 days spent travelling the length of England on public buses, exploring the issues faced with service quality and the disabled bus pass.

title: Pyohaerok
overview: A silent film made at sea.

title: Dark Hours
overview: When a hacker hired by a mysterious entity discovers that there is more than one party interested in the task he was assigned, not only will his job be at risk, but also his life.

original_title: Solann en concert aux Vieilles Charrues 2025

overview: A young man returns to a place that no longer feels like home. Along the way, old melodies echo through memories he can’t outrun.

title: Trick or Treat with Reed Richmond
original_title: Trick or Treat with Reed Richmond
overview: Join cult icon Reed Richmond (star of beloved b-movies like “Hell Ninja 4” & “Beverly Hills Graverobber”) on a jack-o-lantern–lit journey through history and mystery as he explores the origins of Halloween and the most memorable monsters it celebrates.

title: SKG: Death Row Records - Thru My Eyez
original_title: SKG: Death Row Records - Thru My Eyez
overview: LA rapper shares her raw journey from troubled youth to Death Row Records artist, facing addiction, loss, and violence while working with legends and finding her path to redemption.

title: Will Burkart: Warm Regards
overview: Comedian Will Burkart's debut comedy special filmed in Sacramento, California.

title: Free Finga: Pasikeist
overview: The concert "Pasikeist" at the Compensa Concert Hall in Vilnius drew you into the visual and mystical world of music from the very first sound. In the ruins of a future house, as the red clock strikes an ever later hour, reality and dreams begin to mix, guests appear and everything is not as it seems.

title: The Night Within
overview: A social worker’s obsession with a case plunges him into a fight for survival against malevolent forces.

title: Soul upon Soul
overview: Playa, after clearing all of the gangs of Birmingham, meets with his boss Set who wishes to tell him their next plans moving forward.

title: Feel My Pain
overview: Struggling rapper Cmills is desperate to help his mother overcome addiction while facing life's challenges. When she's diagnosed with cancer, he must decide: give up his music to support her or pursue his dreams to honor her legacy through his songs.

title: Spiderman Homeless
overview: In an alternate universe, a homeless superhero must navigate the harsh realities of society while battling the growing homelessness crisis in Australia, fighting for justice in a world that has abandoned him.

title: Un grito en silencio
overview: Oliver was a happy man but his recent divorce has forced him to abandon himself, due to the clinical depression. During terrible episodes of depression, he realize the strong bonds he has created over time.

title: Перфекционист
overview: Igor and Natasha are a young couple. They love each other, despite the opposite characters. Igor is a perfectionist, he lives by a schedule, everything is in order for him. Natasha is free, impulsive, living outside the rules. Their differences often cause conflicts and one day bring Igor to a nervous breakdown. After which Natasha does the impossible, proving that a woman is capable of anything for the sake of love, even straightening the Leaning Tower of Pisa. Because love will save the world.

title: Dead End
overview: After witnessing his best friend Alex’s death in a tragic accident, fifteen-year-old Michael finds himself trapped in a time loop of the same day, each reset bringing more pain, hallucinations, and impossible choices — until he realizes the only way out may be to stop trying to fix the past and accept the one thing he fears most: letting go.

title: Rosa
overview: Rosa is tired of living without purpose. What would she do to take control of her own destiny?

title: HIM
overview: Leo recalls his old love, Joe. He misses him dearly. When Leo imagines Joe being present in his life again, he doesn’t know how to feel. Everything’s the same about him: his eyes, his hair, his lips, and that necklace. The last thing Leo heard was that Joe has a girlfriend now, Juliane. Leo thought he had moved on; it's been a tough two years, but when Leo suddenly starts remembering everything they’ve done together, he doesn’t want this wishful thinking to end.

overview: Apollo, a nervous 21 year old trans boy feels stuck and lonely. One night, he attends Transcendence, a club night for trans people.

title: Shrill
overview: Joana, a film director with an identity and career crisis, is wrapping up a documentary about Sandra, the clientless touristic guide of a very untouristic walking trail.

title: The Roads We Travel
overview: Torn between her family and her dreams, Tamara must choose which path she'll choose. An encounter with an old classmate shows her the two may not be as different as she imagined.

title: What Happines
overview: As a boy, the director was sure about it: his uncle Massimo and Lucio Dalla were the same person. In the film he explores that impossible similarity, complicated and remarkable, which helped him understand his uncle’s disability. As he observes his daily life, Lucio Dalla comes back, singing of loneliness, anger, and freedom.

title: Withhold
overview: New father Adam visits his estranged dad, Paul, in a bid to reconcile a painful past. But as buried memories and resentments surface, the day spirals into a raw confrontation neither is ready for.
