overview: A documentary covering the reasons for the collapse of human civilizations of the past, while warning about potential threats to the existing civilization.

title: Fixation
overview: A struggling musician becomes horrifyingly fixated on a bell while practicing a song.

title: Pulpitum
overview: Determined to find her missing sister, Claire investigates her small town’s mysterious church rituals and battles fragmented visions, cryptic encounters, ever-present surveillance, and a dangerously unorthodox society.

title: Sorry for Fucking Up Your Place
original_title: Sorry for Fucking Up Your Place
overview: This documentary dives into Tromsø's vibrant street art scene, following two local graffiti writers. In a city known for its wild nature and extreme seasons, a subculture of expression and rebellion flourishes. The film explores questions of public space, community, and voice in a remote but connected place.

title: Graham Greene: I'm Just Me
overview: Behind every great role is an actor bold enough to believe in himself. In this surrealist sketch, we learn lessons on acting and life—straight from the fox’s mouth.

title: The Analysis of Mind
overview: The film begins with two crowds dressed in black, either  walking left or right. Suddenly, a young person dressed in  orange (symbolic of curiosity) enters the frame, with a  question mark visible on the back of their clothes. After  surveying the crowds, the orange figure decides to follow  their path briefly, before turning away – revealing a  lightbulb on the front of their clothes. Proceeding forward,  the orange figure notices a space full of white blocks. They  initially inspect them, before starting to build a small wall.

title: Christopher MacArthur-Boyd: Scary Times
overview: A stand-up comedy special by Christopher Macarthur-Boyd, recorded at the Pavilion Theatre in November 2024.

title: RED
overview: Before Blou Klip, and before Screwjob, Mikey was an unhinged man taking names and sending a message.

title: Historias de Terror en un Pueblo Castellano
original_title: Historias de Terror en un Pueblo Castellano
overview: The last hours of eight university students were recorded on camera, that is the last thing anyone heard from them.

title: Carrousel
overview: In one of the most polluted regions of France, a small industrial town by the Mediterranean Sea lives in striking contrast, where smokestacks loom and super tankers drift by, yet people swim, dance, and savour life. Amid the haze of factories and the hum of semi-trailers, a resilient community clings to joy and routine. At the edge of the freeway, Natalie’s food truck has stood for thirty years, serving as a symbol of perseverance and humanity. This visually rich, emotionally resonant film captures the paradox of living between industrial ruin and natural beauty, where survival means choosing not to look right at the smoke, but left, towards the sea.

title: Point Nemo
overview: What happens when laziness become a matter of life and death? On a world where absurd is the accepted norm, we find three slackers who are so lazy, they'd rather risk their lives than exert themselves. Their travels are marked by the presence of an unlikely entourage, consisting of a priest grappling with doubt, a policeman torn between duty and despair, a toy seller sowing joy and cunningness, and a mysterious individual clad in a fiery red suit.

title: GAMA
overview: A storyteller of peace serves as a guide in the “Gama”—natural caves where many local people lost their lives during the Battle of Okinawa. The woman in blue standing by his side represents the intersection of the present and the past.

title: Orbis
overview: Orbis is, above all, a short film that portrays a man who can revisit his decisions through his inhuman ability.

title: Should Anyone Be Ashamed Of Their Nation's History? Should Anyone Be Proud Of It?
original_title: Should Anyone Be Ashamed Of Their Nation's History? Should Anyone Be Proud Of It?
overview: A documentary exploring national responsibility, guilt and pride vs. shame in regarding one's history.

original_title: Grandir en France : les enfants ont la parole

title: Mutant Fish!
overview: When a couple goes swimming at an empty lake in the outskirts of New Jersey, they quickly find out why no one is there!

overview: A feature-length documentary that tells the story of the Censorship of Films Act 1923 and how one  canny term in that statute has allowed consecutive holders of the role of Film Censor to reflect the prevailing values of Irish society over the last 100 years.

original_title: The Rich & Poor: 1000 Player Civilization Experiment
overview: Popular Minecraft YouTuber ish simulates a world divided into those with abundant resources and those without. With free reign, kingdoms rise and fall, nobodies become emperors and chaos forever ensues.

title: Dance Master
overview: From Riverdance star to pioneering choreographer, Breandán de Gallai charts one man's artistic and personal journey through five decades of Irish cultural transformation, blending tradition, identity, and grief into groundbreaking new forms of Irish dance.

title: Guyver: Midnight
overview: When Chronos kidnaps Sho’s friend, Mizuki, he must become the Guyver to eliminate Chronos’ soldiers known as ‘Zoanoids’ in order to rescue her.

title: The Bear Inside a Whale
overview: Stan Hill Jr. is a Haudenosaunee artist living in Miawpukek First Nation Reserve, Conne River, Newfoundland. In “The Bear Inside a Whale,” he and his family discuss racism, identity, religion, creation and art, along with the cultural extinction of the Beothuk of Newfoundland. Throughout the film, we follow Stan carving a bear out of a whale vertebra. And we visit The Rooms (museum) in St. John’s, Newfoundland, where Stan talks about viewing and reclaiming Indigenous artefacts.

title: The Transgender Puppet Variety Show
overview: Come and join Eleutheria the Puppet and her fluffy friends at The Transgender Puppet Variety Show.

title: Born to Fake
overview: In 1996, one of the biggest media scandals in German history shook the public: Michael Born, a self-made journalist, had faked over twenty reports for the newly established private television station between 1990 and 1996. Some seemed amateurish, others dealt with absurd topics: child labor for IKEA in India, drug addicts licking toads to get high, and the Ku Klux Klan in the Eifel region were just some of his numerous fabrications. How did it come to this? Was Michael Born an enlightened figure who subversively exposed the tabloid system, a victim of the system, or simply a bumbling fraud? Film traces Michael Born's footsteps. Put together from hundreds of hours of raw material and the memories of former companions, an incredible story of forgery emerges. A media-theoretical film about levels of reality, fake news, and the question: Why do we actually believe what we see?

title: WICKET
overview: A feature documentary that chronicles the rise of legendary Bboy Wicket, famed for his explosive power moves and seamless footwork that redefined breakdancing. From San Francisco's Renegade Rockers to learning from East Coast icon Flomaster, Wicket fused styles into a groundbreaking form. But behind the fame, Gabriel Jaochico grappled with hiding his identity as a gay man. Featuring electrifying '90s battle footage and candid interviews, the film explores his dual journey—dance stardom and personal liberation. It's a powerful, joyful tribute to self-expression, resilience, and the courage to live authentically.

title: Dream!
overview: A young girl lives in the mountains of Northern Thailand. When she is tragically orphaned, she sets out on a lone quest for a new home and family. Her journey will take her across Thailand, and bring many adventures.

title: Alien Interview: The Movie
overview: The feature film version of the "Alien Interview", where all will be revealed.

title: Wu Kids

title: Ninochka
overview: Konstantin goes for a walk in the forest with his acquaintance. He gradually plunges into his own world of fears and cruelty. A fatal event that happens late in the evening turns the hero's idea about himself upside down. The next day, Konstantin returns to his usual routine, as if the entire previous day and night had been erased from his memory.

title: The Endless Loop
overview: After a long day, Kai returns home and finds a strange note warning there's no escape. Dismissing it as a prank, he enters the lift, only to become trapped in a repeating cycle. No matter what he tries to do, he can’t break free. Will he ever escape this endless loop?

title: Ghost Square
overview: Boss invites his two friends to explore “Ghost Square” a mysterious neighborhood no one dares enter after dark. There, they discover a strange piece of paper that traps them in a terrifying game: complete 5 tasks before 2 a.m. or they’ll never be able to leave. But when morning comes.. a shocking truth is revealed.. and nothing is quite what it seemed.

title: Anemia

title: Malachi

Interviews with Malachi’s biological parents, foster parents, and medical staff, combined with powerful animation, reveal the trauma of abandonment and its impact is revealed: the parents wrestling with guilt while longing for forgiveness, Bat Sheva’s boundless love, and Malachi’s journey to understand himself and his past. The film explores human complexity, responsibility, and the possibility of redemption amidst pain.

title: Well Done C.A. Sahab!

overview: “I love films that foreground the fact that you are watching film,” states British director Mark Jenkin, who in his film diary returns, among others, to the Cornwall locations which gave rise to his mesmeric Enys Men. The series of Super8 shots taken from his travels and the comprehensive voice-overs make for a fascinating mosaic of encounters, observations, formative quotations from cinematic and other works, and also possible fantasies. Here, Jenkin demonstrates his ability to give his films an appealing timeless quality and to connect the familiar with the curiously enigmatic. One hundred and one interesting facts from the filmmaker’s diary. (Viktor Palák)

title: To Novosibirsk

Sana sets out on an adventure with her shaman younger sibling to meet a baby spirit, in order to change her fate (palja), into the spirit world where the ancestral gods are said to govern the Four Pillars of Destiny (sajupalja).

title: Martin Nørgaard: Ironisk?

But when urban development forces its demolition, a wave of grief sweeps through those who called it home.  Through powerful, intimate moments, this deeply human story explores loss not tied to death, but to place, memory, and identity. Guided by the five stages of grief, director Ota invites us to reflect on what it means to say goodbye not just to a building, but to a vital space of connection, healing, and shared life.

title: Left

title: Barranquilla To The World

Through his encounters with experts and witnesses, Julian explores the French legacy in the delicate art of stained glass and in the foundations of local education, culminating in the vibrant presence of institutions such as the Alliance Française, demonstrating that this historical connection is still alive and enriching Barranquilla's present.

title: ALL THE ANGELS
overview: Dealing with the loss of a loved one, Riley begins to torment themselves. Grappling with the guilt, they begin to change. Something is haunting them, and they must figure out what before it's too late.

title: White Ladybug

original_title: Vincent Delerm en concert à Cannes

title: The Promise
overview: The Promise shares the powerful true story of Miguel and Laura Lopez, missionaries who left behind comfort and success to bring the hope of the gospel to the remote jungles of Papua, Indonesia.  Raised in Colombia, Miguel pursued dentistry with dreams of wealth, while Laura returned to the mission field as a teacher. But God had bigger plans. Together, they faced near-death illness, spiritual warfare, and deep cultural challenges—yet witnessed incredible transformation as the love of Christ reached places it had never gone before.  From training locals in dental care to rescuing vulnerable children and sharing the gospel in unreached villages, their story is a raw and inspiring look at what happens when ordinary people say “yes” to an extraordinary God.  A story of sacrifice, healing, and hope—this is The Promise.

title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Chapon no Hero!

The film follows the group Okus Meda and Bihać musicians who, in the hardest days of the war - amidst shells and ruins - created music that brought hope, laughter and humanity. Through archival footage, honest interviews and testimonies, the film reveals how music became the mainstay of a city that did not have much, but had a soul. This film is more than a document of a time. This is Duratović's personal dedication to his father and the band Okus Meda, the people who shaped his life with their example, deeds and songs.

Through witty yet biting narration, the film peels back the layers of moral absurdity in society, questioning the line between cleverness and crime. A social critique wrapped in satire and irony.

title: The Essence of Eva

title: A Visual Storm

Rejecting artistic and ideological conformity, Caminati plunges the viewer into subconscious undercurrents arising when storm-force nature trumps conventional ideologies.

title: Конец концов

Each person came up with a character. How would they like to meet the end? What scares them and what can give them hope? Collective life in difficult conditions led to the stories intersecting and the boundaries between people and characters disappearing.

The film juxtaposes surrealist elements with a visceral portrayal of the loneliness and fear of being stateless.

overview: Three fathers—divorced, estranged, and quietly forgotten—struggle to hold on to their children and their sense of worth in a world that often expects men to move on without breaking. As love fades and families fracture, they must fight for connection before it’s too late. BELAIAN TERAKHIR is a tender, unflinching portrait of fatherhood, grief, and resilience in the face of love that no longer looks their way.

A film about the end of the world and the end of a roll of toilet paper. In his deftly playful work shot on 16mm, filmmaker (and musician) Ondřej Vavrečka reminisces, says his farewells and also reflects on the limits of progress. Via three fictional characters, each of whom responds differently to the impulses of their surroundings, he simultaneously enhances the sensitivity of the film audience. Will a pain we experience leave a scar or merely a colourless memory? And will someone remember the old Vysočany station a hundred years from now? In its poetic charm this cinematic piece is almost tactile in nature; it awakens all the senses and, in places, bears the hallmark of Jan Švankmajer, if the latter had been born an essential optimist, that is. Film as a whisper emanating from smiling lips. (Viktor Palák, KVIFF)

title: Zadorny
overview: The story of a racehorse named Zadorny in a film that combines documentary footage with 3D animation. The stallion originates from a stud farm in eastern Ukraine, where Daria’s great-grandfather used to work. By following the paths of Zadorny’s offspring, who compete across the world, Daria explores her personal migration experience and investigates the exchange of resources between Eastern and Western Europe.

title: Fates Aligning
overview: It's a bright and calming day until an explosion erupts causing distress in the sky, leaving a beautiful image but inflicting harm. All of our fates align.

title: These Days
overview: A young woman leaves behind the restless São Paulo to begin a new chapter in the small town of Garbagna Novarese, in northern Italy. Through quiet, intimate moments of daily life, the film captures her silent negotiation between nostalgia and discovery.  "Questi Giorni" is a slice-of-life short that gently explores identity, adaptation, and the quiet beauty found in routine.

title: From the Mountain We See the Mountain
original_title: Desde La Montaña Vemos La Montaña
overview: From the Mountain We See the Mountain blends haunting imagery and whispered myth to explore a land marked by ecological trauma and the colonial experience. As animals and humans cautiously re-emerge after a forest fire, rumours swirl: was it an accident, an act of nature, or something more insidious? Through eerie nighttime scenes, surreal lighting and interviews lit by the flicker of imagined flames, the film evokes a sense of environmental dystopia and quiet resistance. Balancing elements of myth, sci-fi and thriller, the film conjures a land reckoning with monsters it did not create.

title: Birr Ambar
overview: New Comedy theater

title: When the Pedals Have Wilted
overview: "Tay Emil, an old padyak driver struggling to renew his franchise, forms an unlikely bond with a young sampaguita vendor, but encounters an incident that will send his wheels tripping."

title: DVOiKA OUCE
overview: A satirical mockumentary follows Ľuboš, a conspiracy theorist ostracized after his parents die of COVID-19, who seizes a new opportunity during the Russo-Ukrainian war: hired to probe an assassination attempt on the prime minister, he unearths “hidden truths” beyond mainstream narratives, but his escalating, dangerous beliefs threaten both himself and those around him.

title: Wacker
overview: The 14 to 16-year-old players of FFC Wacker from Munich use the time before and after the matches for a personal conversation. The game of soccer brings together young people from different social and ethnic backgrounds.

title: As The Water Flows
overview: The story of a widowed old man living by the Green Lake in Kunming, trying to heal the emotional trauma of three generations and rebuild family ties.

title: Wright Brothers: The Musical
overview: How many ideas have you given up on because of your own self doubt?  Wilbur Wright must overcome his self-doubt with his brother Orville to achieve their dream of becoming the fathers of modern aviation. And they’ll sing while they do it.

title: Spark of Life
overview: A female firefighter dies in the line of duty. Before her death, she signed an organ donation contract and her heart is transplanted, to a badly wounded firefighter and a critically ill girl. Two souls who are constantly struggling meet in fantasy, interpreting the power and temperature of life.

title: Maldoror
overview: Arya, an aspiring novelist, begins work on her new book about a malevolent figure named Maldoror. As she writes, Maldoror comes to life and torments her in order to consume her soul. Arya fights to retain her sanity as the boundary between the written word and real world starts to blur.

title: Coming Attractions
overview: In the days before home video killed the theatrical market for erotic cinema, movie trailers were a mainstay of the gay porno theatergoing experience. Viewed now, they provide a fascinating—and often very entertaining—look at the way these films were marketed and sold, filled with lurid taglines, false promises, personal messages from the stars, and surprisingly creative editing. This collection of original trailers has been newly preserved in 2K from rare 16mm materials and features previews for films by such auteurs as Tom DeSimone, Joe Gage, Fred Halsted, William Higgins, Wakefield Poole, Toby Ross, and Steve Scott, plus a surprise or two. And don’t forget—as one trailer notes, “It’s Rated X, so come with a grownup.”

title: Moment
overview: A meditative 3D animation, rich with texture and the ambiance of the natural world, that beckons us to find solace in turbulent times.

title: The Degenerate: The Life and Films of Andy Milligan
original_title: The Degenerate: The Life and Films of Andy Milligan
overview: Before unsung gay NYC exploitation maverick Andy Milligan died of AIDS, he cranked out grindhouse-ready shock and so-bad-it’s-good schlock movies throughout the late 1960s and ’70s. Yet, as captured in this fascinating documentary, his life and on-set persona were messy, complicated, and unforgettable.

title: The Boundary
overview: Transform the object of manipulation into a part of your creative expression.

title: Estatuas de noche
overview: Alessandro, a young, idealistic, and romantic film director, crosses paths with Emma, a perfectionist theatre actress whose dream is to perform on stages across Europe. Their fleeting encounter, portrayed through a non-conventional structure reminiscent of *Bohemian Lights*, reveals that love appears when and where we least expect it.  We accompany the protagonists on a journey through a timeless Madrid, filled with colorful characters such as: a megalomaniacal and jealous actor named The Interesting Actor; an obscene film producer called Stefano Clemente; and a priest and a nun searching for anisette. These almost phantasmagorical figures compel the two young protagonists to question their ways of believing and loving.

title: Small Town Spectres
overview: A crowbar-wielding serial killer makes a shocking comeback. Determined to uncover the truth and gain closure, Jessica Miller teams up with her cousin to document the killer responsible for her parents’ murder.

title: The Backup Career
overview: Introspective look into the competitive film industry and what safety nets need to be put in place to have successful career.

title: Páramos de leyendas
overview: At the highest point of Venezuela, where the fog envelops the memory of time and the wind whispers ancestral tales, Páramos de Leyendas reveals, through portraits of muleteers and peasants, the courage of those who braved the heights and the relentless cold, often barefoot and wearing only a poncho. In this hostile environment, tough personalities were forged, but with an unparalleled spark of humor and wisdom.

title: Nuisibles de l'été, la guerre est déclarée
original_title: Nuisibles de l'été, la guerre est déclarée

title: Canary Islands
overview: Manuch, the head of the drug mafia, agrees to temporarily release Bijan and Naeem from prison so they can finish their unfinished business...

title: Monumenting
overview: As monuments continue to be toppled, relocated and reassessed all over the world, this documentary takes us to Dubai, Kuwait City, Abu Dhabi and Sanaa, questioning what defines monuments -what they are and what they could become, while retracing their non-linear biographical trajectories. In these cities, they have been virtually understudied and their stories remain invisible. Monumenting retraces them as we follow how participants to the research process engage in guessing rather than asserting what they know. Without noticing it, we are invited into a research journey in which diverse voices offer an unusual approach to cities in the Arabian Peninsula and a kaleidoscopic mapping of monuments and memory.

title: Amor e Morte em Julio Reny
original_title: Amor e Morte em Julio Reny

title: Welcome Home
overview: Two young and queer friends from the Faroe Islands have left their home but still live in its shadow. The film is a firework of poetics and tells the story of friendship, polarization and belonging.

title: April Hubbard: Leading by Example
overview: Many doors closed on April Hubbard when she became a wheelchair user. But one by one, she knocked them down anyway.

title: The Power of Ink
overview: When society divides into sectors and drones are everywhere, who can you really trust?

title: Edmonton To Milan
overview: Exploration of the human souls desire to move, and needs for safety.

title: Perfect Appreciation
overview: In the near future, movie theaters begin to disappear. Just as Doo-soo is about to take his own life, he receives a call from a theater offering to screen his film. Inside, the movie begins, and Doo-soo watches it in a perfectly quiet and private setting. However, a woman sitting behind him keeps interrupting with questions about the film. Furious that his final cinematic experience has been ruined, Doo-soo loses his temper at the woman.

title: The Sinister Cinema Story
overview: “Great! A story that NEEDS to be told!” – Joe Dante, Director, GREMLINS, THE BURBS“The Sinister Cinema Story” takes you behind the scenes of the oldest, weirdest video distributor of Sci-Fi, Fantasy, Horror and Exploitation cinema. Operating out of Medford, Oregon since the late 80s!

title: Family Recipe
overview: An intimate look at a Mexican-Lebanese couple’s life through archival footage spanning 48 years. Told from the perspective of their youngest daughter, the film explores their relationship, gender roles, and the influence of cultural traditions on identity.

title: Mango Seed
overview: After an ordinary day at the produce markets, Zhan is met with the announcement that his daughter is moving to another city to pursue her dreams. Faced with the approaching separation, he struggles to express to her the words in his heart.

title: The Kitchen
overview: The static environment of the kitchen will be disrupted by the arrival of a young woman - a new cook, with her efforts to adapt to the strictly defined working conditions and fit into the settled routine. When she realizes that the mechanism is starting to put a high pressure on her and destroying her individuality, it will be too late to free herself from the system she became a part of.

title: Susan
overview: While tirelessly advocating for others, Susan Suchan navigates a cruel life predicament, and secretly devises an unorthodox plan to control mortality.

title: Holidays
overview: Found footage film about Soviet holiday rituals

title: A Bee and a Silkworm
overview: Retired botanist Dongho lives alone, tending to his greenhouse. He cares for wild bees, makes seed bombs, and struggles to preserve the alpine plants he brought down from Mt. Baekdu a decade ago. One day, he encounters twelve-year-old Bom, who visits his yard in search of mulberry leaves for the silkworms Bom is raising. As a bond is cultivated between them, Bom suddenly disappears, leaving only a note and a silkworm kit behind. After waiting a few days, Dong-ho sets out with a sense of foreboding to find Bom.

title: Randevular
overview: Set in 1987, the film focuses on the changing life of Ferit, a medical doctor, following the death of his future wife, Nuray. After this tragic event, Ferit resigns from his profession and devotes his entire life to communicating with the dead. Thanks to academic Figen, Ferit is able to communicate with Nuray, but what he learns will upset all the balances.

title: Headstone
overview: After the death of their father, two brothers find themselves in conflict over what kind of headstone to place on his grave. What begins as a disagreement over a simple decision gradually evolves into a deeper, emotional confrontation that forces them to confront their differences, their past, and their shared grief

title: Step Through the Memories
overview: Before the graduation day, Cetta was assigned to make a video compilation of school farewells while also repairing his relationship with his friends at school.

title: Cyclone
overview: Dayse, a Brazilian playwright known as Cyclone, wants to study in Paris. Having a career in theater is unthinkable for a woman in São Paulo in 1918. But her director doesn’t want her to go, as he would lose his mistress and ghostwriter. When she becomes pregnant by him, her dream starts to fade. An artist’s struggle for self-determination in a patriarchal society, based on the true story of Daisy Pontes and modernist Oswald de Andrade.

title: Crazy For You
overview: In the heart of Spain's rural Y2K, Alma is 16 and desperate to be seen—especially by the village’s heartthrob, José. Overlooked by everyone, she finds an unexpected guide in a strange, staring cow that draws her toward something deeper than the attention she craves.

title: Ceremony
overview: Maria Valenzuela is lead conductor of the Guadalajara Philharmonic. She aspires to be recognized internationally. Challenged by the presence of a young and new conductor who just arrived.

title: Ballad of a Jutland girl
overview: The tragic story of the worshipped and woeful Barbara from north Jutland. A weeping hillside angel, who was lured to her drowning death after a sapphic heartbreak

title: Baby
overview: At an east London house party, Red grapples with second-hand grief as she struggles to support Axel through the silent weight of his father's death— each scene revealing a new stage of mourning in a raw, dialogue-light portrait of love, loss, and emotional endurance.

title: The Deal
overview: Two men arrive at Johnny's house for drugs, but one of them seems uneasy about the prospect. Inside, they get caught up in a game of distrust, murder mysteries and 70s film.

title: I Am Not Invisible
overview: Yuki York’s self-reflexive documentary is a personal essay, shot in an impoverished district of the Philippines, deemed “invisible” by York’s on-screen text. Tracing York’s roots, I Am Not Invisible asks local residents innocuous questions about their lives to better understand them, in turn offering to better understand York’s own Filipina grandmother.

title: Doora Teera Yaana
overview: Musicians and techies Akash and Bhoomi, bound by a five-year relationship, begin to question their future before their wedding. To find clarity, they embark on a soul-searching road trip together.

title: The Marathon Runner
overview: Meet the Marathon Runner and his endless race.

title: My Rookie Secret Agent Lover
overview: Rookie agent Ryan investigates CEO Vincent, accidentally kisses him, and accepts his proposal. Working undercover at Vincent's company, another is thought to be Vincent's lover. As feelings deepen, Ryan's true identity surfaces.

title: Hebbuli Cut
overview: Hebbuli Cut is a tender and timely reflection on social injustice, childhood desires, and the immense strength required to claim one`s dignity in an unequal world. Told with warmth, humour, and heartache, it`s a poignant story for anyone who has ever dared to dream.

title: Kielbasy Heaven
overview: Now on their fourth generation, the Kowalonek's family has maintained their Kielbasy Shop in Shenandoah, Pennsylvania for 114 years, serving the community through thick and thin.

title: of Gold
overview: Set against the glistening backdrop of Porto’s Douro River, "de Ouro" is a quiet, three-minute drift through a world often overlooked. Captured in a grainy 5:4 frame that evokes the feel of a memory, this observational short film invites the viewer aboard a simple river cruise — not for grandeur, but for the fleeting poetry of sunlight on water, a breeze through aged stone. More impression than narrative, "de Ouro" gently reminds us that the smallest moments — like the river’s golden glimmer — are often the ones that stay with us, etched not in time, but in feeling.

title: My Online Crush Is My Contract Husband
original_title: My Online Crush Is My Contract Husband
overview: A quirky nurse unknowingly falls for her billionaire boss through an anonymous dating app. When fate forces them into a contract marriage to fulfill his grandfather's dying wish, their online crush and real-life tension collide. Between steamy misunderstandings, family drama, and sweet chaos, love may just find its way—on and off the screen.

title: Mergen
overview: In a remote Kyrgyz village where gold mining and poaching rule, an investigator begins to see inherited visions that reveal a dark connection between a poaching king, a murdered girl, and a deadly conspiracy surrounding an abandoned gold mine.

title: FITTING ROOM
overview: ONE DAY, TEN PEOPLE - HOW DO THEY ALL CONNECT?  OUR CHARACTERS INTERACT WITH EACH OTHER IN THE BUILD UP TO A GIG THEY ALL ATTEND, THROUGH VHS FLASHBACKS WE UNVEIL WHAT HAS HAPPENED BETWEEN THEM.  FITTING ROOM IS AN EXPERIMENTAL SHORT THAT PLAYS WITH THE COMING-OF-AGE GENRE. UNLIKE MOST COMING-OF-AGE TALES, NO STORY IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN ANOTHER AND NO ONE IS THE NARRATIVE FAVOURITE.  IT AIMS TO UNIFY THOSE WATCHING THROUGH THE MEMORY OF FEELING, NOT THE SPECIFICITY OF EXPERIENCE.  EACH CHARACTER IS GOING THROUGH THEIR OWN DIFFICULTY WITH GROWING-UP BUT FITTING ROOM HIGHLIGHTS HOW NO ONE DOES THIS ALONE AND HOW WE LEARN FROM EACH OTHER CAN AT TIMES BE THE MOST IMPORTANT LESSONS OF ALL.

title: Don't Take It Personally
overview: A film that emerges from the sonic and visual power of a concert by Croatian musicians Alen and Nenad Sinkauz and a performance by Dutch-Indonesian dancer Marije Nie. Historical denial, collective violence and resistance are intertwined.

title: Danse Macabre
overview: Combining poetry, dance, music, and archival audio, Danse Macabre paints a portrait of the human psyche, drawing on the work of Dr Carl Jung. The film explores the different aspects of the conscious and unconscious minds which are represented through character performances from dancers, singers, unseen voices, and musicians. Underscoring the film is the wisdom of ancestral memory, depicted via the embodied knowledge of the Yoruba Egúngún masquerade. The work is an inquiry into the human condition, exploring the parallels between modern psychology, aspects of Yoruba culture, and east Asian understandings around life force and energy.

title: Second Date with Wet Sara
overview: An awkward date gets spooky.

title: Apocalypse Mart
overview: A married couple who own a Madura small shop that they say will only close on apocalypse day want to be intimate again. But the husband doesn't want to close the small shop because he thinks the apocalypse would happen if he does.

title: Murder in Glitterball City
overview: Louisville, Kentucky is the home of the glitterball, and after a body is found in a basement of a Victorian mansion, two lovers accuse each other of committing murder. What follows is an exploration of a toxic relationship in a town where ghosts and secrets don’t always stay buried.

title: The Broken R
overview: This intimate journey about self-acceptance follows Ricardo, a 24-year-old man born with Treacher Collins Syndrome, who has struggled to pronounce the letter R since birth.

title: The Blue Brazili
overview: In the Iraqi city of Erbil, a group of young people struggle amidst unstable economic, political, and social conditions that push them into a series of unexpected events.

title: The Deafening Sound of Silence
overview: Following the disappearance of his best friend, a boy is haunted by a ghost who speaks in a language he cannot understand.

title: Lullaby for the Mountains
overview: In this hypnotic odyssey, the ancient monasteries of Armenia’s highlands bear traces of epochs past. Landscapes give way to soundscapes, and the shadowy depths within.

title: Limbo
overview: He sinks… Little by little. Eloïse. His obsession. Eloïse… Everywhere. All the time. Eloïse. His disturbed mind slips into the limbo. He starts following her. Eloïse. No one else. The one. The only.

title: В поисках движения
overview: A dancer in a static pose on the screen. Is there movement? It seems not. But the film of the movie camera is moving, filming the dancer. Electrons are running, pixels of the digital matrix are changing. Does this mean that movement is happening? The dancer's body comes to life within the frame set by the cameraman. How does this frame and the dancer's choreography interact? Should the frame obey the laws of choreography or exist in counterpoint with it? Or, perhaps, should it freeze, allowing the dancer to create his own pattern within the frame? The dancer makes his body move according to the laws of choreography. But at the same time, his nature determines how the body will exist within this choreography. After all, nature created the plasticity of the body outside of choreographies and directorial tasks. So what is more interesting to watch? What is the real beauty - in an artificial, memorized choreographic movement or in a natural, random gesture?

title: Spoiler Alert
overview: Sara is a wife who loves describing the movie she's watching with her husband. This action leads to her husband and other moviegoers in the movie theater feeling uncomfortable.

title: Leave a Message
overview: After the passing of his father, Tristan decides to go on a trip to the Lake District. Whilst there, he is forced to face his grief head on and come to terms with the painful truth.

title: Taxi Driver Who Caught the Murderer
overview: A taxi driver named Seung-beom discovers that one of his passengers is a murderer. Aspiring to become a national hero as "the taxi driver who caught a killer," he soon finds that the road to fame is far from smooth.

title: The Visitor
overview: End of summer. Danielius (in mid 30s) makes a return to his hometown to sell his parents' flat. Having nowhere to rush, he reconnects with people and the town that's no longer his. He is confronted with a quiet sense of loneliness.

title: Avant de rentrer...
overview: Lost along the road, someone enters the forest...

title: A Game To Remember
overview: A small community of passionate ice hockey players from around the North East of England reflect on mental health, fellowship, and loss, as they share a last game with their lost teammate and celebrate his passion for the sport.

title: Fugazi
overview: FUGAZI is an experimental short film that explores the genesis of space through the presence of sound. Inspired by Leibniz’s relational theory, the film suggests that space only exists when it is inhabited, in this case, by sound. Through a sensory and progressive montage, sound reveals, transforms, and collapses space, guiding the viewer through cycles of creation and dissolution. It is an audiovisual experience about the invisible becoming visible when heard.

title: UNFINISHED
overview: "UNFINISHED" represents a life left on hold. This film depicts a repetition of the days that follow. A mental spiral that seems to have no end and, because of it, everything remains unfinished. A mix of everyday reality with what goes on in the imprisoned mind that, due to its own problems and frustrations, ends up becoming increasingly involved in its thoughts and stuck in a routine at home, while life outside remains "unfinished."

title: 2024 TAEMIN WORLD TOUR [Ephemeral Gaze]
overview: SHINee's Taemin held his first solo world tour Ephemeral Gaze from August 2024 to March 2025, greeting fans in 27 cities all over the world. The powerful solo artist kicked off the tour in South Korea with two shows in Incheon, where he brought captivating stages of his hit songs like Danger, Sexy in the Air, Déjà vu, The Unknown Sea, G.O.A.T., Crush and Say Less.

title: Dasos
overview: After climate events devastate Earth, a group of explorers sets out on an expedition to a planet. The crew survives after the ship crashes into the ocean, and together they will have to fight to survive the dangers that exist in this new environment.

title: The Prodigy: Live from Glastonbury 2025
overview: BBC Four’s Glastonbury coverage closes with original rave pioneers The Prodigy in their first appearance at the festival since the death of frontman Keith Flint in 2019.

title: Black Feeling
overview: Black Feeling is an atmospheric short film that ties psychological thriller with supernatural realism to examine identity, emotional contagion, and queer intimacy at its most volatile.  The story follows Kamsi, a young woman who isn’t like other people. She feels everything, literally. Her rare condition forces her to absorb the emotions of everyone around her. But when she falls for Audrey, a magnetic woman harbouring her own mysterious illness, Kamsi’s world fractures in ways she can no longer control.  What begins as a sensual, emotionally intense relationship quickly turns unsettling. Kamsi is haunted by visions, disoriented by feelings that aren’t hers, and drawn deeper into a reality that no longer has clear edges. Audrey’s presence is both intoxicating and corrupting, an emotional virus infecting Kamsi’s already fragile grip on selfhood.

title: Mundus Relinquit
overview: Trying to escape her abusive husband, Esther tries to be selected by extraterrestrials to live with them, but to do that she will have to face a man who believes the extraterrestrials will destroy the world.

title: Blink
overview: Blink is a micro horror film created in under 24 hours.  Made with minimal resources, this short leans on pure tension, timing, and fear.

title: Fubica
overview: Discover the captivating origins of an iconic little pickup from the 1960s that was transformed into a 'triozinho' and captured the hearts of countless 'foliões' during Carnaval. Through heartfelt memories, interviews, and breathtaking landscapes, this documentary, directed by Daniel Bittencourt, beautifully reveals how a group of passionate music lovers gave birth to one of Linhares’ most cherished cultural symbols, straight from Vila de Regência.

title: El tesoro
overview: A humble recycler finds what he believes to be an ancient treasure of great value. With no answers in his small town, he decides to embark with his best friend on a journey to the big city, dreaming of selling it and changing his life.

title: The Last Package for Mama
overview: On the first day of their mother's funeral, while Namsu and her older sister Suyeon are asleep, their mother's spirit appears in front of the funeral hall. When Namsu wakes up, she encounters her mother, who asks her to retrieve a delivery package before the burial ceremony. Over the matter of their mother's package, the sisters' mourning begins to drift apart, gradually separating them in their grief.

title: Meat
overview: By a riverside tree, a man mercilessly beats a mysterious sack. Black fluid seeps, flames rise, and a grotesque meal follows. No matter how hard he scrubs, the stains remain. As guilt resurfaces, he comes face to face with the hell he thought he had buried.

title: The Treatment
overview: Trapped in a sterile labyrinth, a patient fights to reclaim her fragmented identity as the lines between guidance, manipulation, and reality blur.

title: Sunday Lunch
overview: Grace, a young closeted lesbian from a devout Catholic family, finally gathers the courage to come out to her parents over the sacred ritual of Sunday lunch. She brings her girlfriend along, hoping for the perfect moment—but every time she tries to speak up, her well-meaning but chaotic family unwittingly derails her plans in increasingly absurd and hilarious ways. What could go wrong? Absolutely everything, in this heartwarming and over-the-top coming-out farce.

title: That Other White Jungle
overview: The mourning for a father and the absences, intertwined with what remains. Letters, written by birds that used to visit the filmmaker when she was a child, now reveal secrets to her son, whom she watches grow up.

title: Sechswochenamt
overview: While the world is in lockdown as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic, Lore has to cope with a painful loss: her mother has died. Back in the small town of Erkelenz in North Rhine-Westphalia, she struggles against entrenched family structures and a paralyzing bureaucracy. Above all, she has to find a way to come to terms with the death and say goodbye to her mother.

title: Orpheus
overview: Fresh out the depths of the Underworld, Orpheus stumbles on a providential fisherman. The peasant helps him to get well and afterward, the talented poet proceeds to tell his story...

title: Who Will Be Remembered Here
overview: Four queer people, in beautiful and striking sites and environments across Scotland, ask questions about the stories we choose to tell and how these stories shape the lives of those who come after us. The film is an archive for the future, claiming space for marginalised cultures, languages and identities.

title: Shadows of Destiny
overview: Five years after the defeat of Bill Cipher, Mabel and Dipper Pines prepares their 18th birthday party. But when Robbie Valentino and his friends break into Ford's inventory of anomalies, a dark force from the past awakens.

title: Sands of Purgatory
overview: In the wasteland of Purgatory, a grieving Artemis sets out on a path of vengeance against the zealots who slaughtered her partner, Rhea.

title: Geomeunyeo
overview: Part of the "floating rocks" series. Geomeunyeo evokes the sea where no water exists and reveals forms where there is no light. When one sense closes, another opens in an endless cycle. Through the filmmaker's intervention, Geomeunyeo repeatedly sinks and resurfaces. Shot on 16mm black-and-white film and hand-processed, Geomeunyeo highlights the physical nature of film and the subtle traces naturally produced during manual development. This repetition creates a poetic rhythm that moves between presence and absence, appearance and disappearance.

title: In The Wake Of Compunction
overview: Upcoming short film

title: The Lady from Constantinople
overview: Persuaded by the janitor's wife, a lively, but lonesome old woman, who is only attached to the world through her cherished objects and memories, decides to exchange her two-room apartment for a smaller one. For a little while her everyday life is changed. She meets and entertains new people every day.

title: Rogue Wave
overview: Eve and Tris build a machine that transforms sound into pure euphoria.  As their invention gains fame, Tris's growing addiction threatens to destroy their partnership and unleash dangerous consequences.

title: Nsala (Reprendre)
overview: Between Belgian colonial archives and images shot in the present, the violence of a dehumanizing economic system is revealed through the story of a couple forced to work in a mine.

title: The Whispers
overview: Few hours after their first meeting at a party, a girl and a boy are lying next to each other.

title: Love & Trouble
overview: A young couple get married with high ideals and hidden pasts. An intimate exploration of traumas and how to negotiate shame, anger and love.

title: in case i never see you again
original_title: in case i never see you again
overview: Enzo returns to his hometown and struggles with guilt when he meets his former girlfriend, Aira, by chance, 10 years after their breakup.

title: Alice in Wonderland II: Lair of the Red Witch
original_title: Alice in Wonderland II: Lair of the Red Witch
overview: Alice continues to be haunted by visions of the Red Queen, finding herself trapped between two worlds

title: The Earth Has Ears
overview: When men take up arms to go against their brothers, women have to take up gravediggers’ shovels. Ceebla (Fardouza Moussa Egueh, who we also saw in Gravedigger’s Wife), refuses to bargain for the cost of her labour. When her grave finally finds a taker, the revenue logic takes an unexpected twist.  The Earth Has Ears is a civil war film without gunfire. It shows how the absurdity of war also turns everyday life at the home front irrational. / MSFF

title: Circumstantial Forgiveness
overview: A friend does something at game night and everyone loves it.

title: Head Above Water
overview: Caught up in the fast flow of life, a fresh high school graduate ignores the looming pressures of university, instead seeking escapism through his companion.

title: The Dreaminess
overview: During a long and lonely drive, Scott Corbyn when he finds an isolated hotel to spend the night  and meets the mysterious Bethany Belline

title: Someday again
overview: Isabella lives for and because of her ailing father, Gabriel, but something has been tormenting her lately. As Isabella tries to stick to her routine, strange things begin to happen — yet she’s not ready to find out what it is.

title: Paranoid
overview: When fear overcomes the mind

title: A New Wave: The Revival of The Beach Theatre
original_title: A New Wave: The Revival of The Beach Theatre
overview: An original documentary by Lunar Speedboat Productions that captures the extraordinary journey of bringing the beloved St. Pete Beach landmark back to life.

title: Fin Taylor: Ask Your Mother
overview: Fin Taylor's 2025 Comedy Special, recorded live at The Forge, Brighton.

title: Broken Past
overview: We follow Max, a young man haunted by the shadows of a troubled and precarious past. As he strives to build a new, peaceful life, a haunting question hangs heavy in the air: can he truly break free from what he once was, or will his past return to shatter the future he's so desperately trying to create?

title: Маэстро
overview: Unlucky university teacher Valentin finds an outlet in leading a student film club, where he makes amateur films with young talents. Valentin believes that a bad streak cannot last forever and that he will definitely get lucky someday. Fate favors the unlucky but talented teacher, and Kirill Kyaro agrees to take part in his new film. While Valentin tries his best to grab luck by the tail, the students of the film club grow up, find themselves and make important life discoveries.

title: Page Five
